Lido.title: Mainnet Launch Lido Protocol di Ethereum dengan 10 genesis node operator
Lido.trigger: Ethereum Beacon Chain launch (Des 2020) menciptakan peluang liquid staking; P2P.org telah membangun MVP selama 2020
Lido.evidence: Phase 1 Launch Date Mainnet 2020-12-17; Phase 3 EV-003 Mainnet Launch; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History Mainnet Launch
Lido.decision: Deploy deposit contract, stETH rebasing token, withdrawal queue v1, oracle v1, node operator registry v1 dengan 10 operator kurasi P2P.org
Lido.immediate_result: TVL ~10.000 ETH minggu pertama; stETH rebasing harian berfungsi; validator rewards terdistribusi
Lido.long_term_impact: Menetapkan arsitektur inti (deposit, stETH, oracle, operator registry) yang bertahan hingga V2; memulai network effect liquid staking
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 1, Phase 3 EV-002, EV-003, Phase 4 Architecture, Technical Upgrade History

Lido.title: TGE LDO Token dengan Liquidity Mining di Curve dan SushiSwap
Lido.trigger: Perlu token governance untuk DAO dan insentif liquidity awal stETH/ETH
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-004 TGE LDO; Phase 6 TGE, Distribution, Vesting Schedule; Phase 5 Token Sale
Lido.decision: Mint 1B LDO fixed supply; alokasi treasury 36.3%, investor 22.18%, team 20%, community 10% (liquidity mining 1 tahun), operator 6.5%; liquidity mining di Curve stETH/ETH + SushiSwap LDO/ETH
Lido.immediate_result: LDO beredar, governance on-chain aktif via Snapshot + Aragon; stETH/ETH pool Curve menjadi deepest liquidity venue
Lido.long_term_impact: Membentuk struktur kepemilikan token yang memengaruhi governance hingga sekarang (treasury 36.3% dominan); Curve menjadi dependency kritis liquidity
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-004, Phase 5 Token Sale, Phase 6 Distribution, Vesting, TGE, Phase 7 Major Integrations (Curve)

Lido.title: Launch Lido on Polygon (stMATIC) — ekspansi multi-chain pertama
Lido.trigger: Polygon tumbuh cepat sebagai L2/sidechain; permintaan liquid staking MATIC
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-006 Launch Polygon; Phase 1 Chains (Polygon); Phase 4 Core Components (stMATIC), Execution Environment; Phase 7 Major Integrations (Polygon)
Lido.decision: Deploy native contracts di Polygon mainnet (bukan bridge stETH); stMATIC rebasing model mirip stETH; subset operator Ethereum
Lido.immediate_result: TVL stMATIC puncak ~$200M (2022); integrasi DeFi Polygon (Aave, QuickSwap, Curve)
Lido.long_term_impact: Membuktikan arsitektur portable ke EVM chain lain; namun kemudian fokus konsolidasi ke Ethereum + L2 (sunset non-EVM chains)
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-006, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Market Timeline

Lido.title: Series A Funding dipimpin Paradigm valuation $73M
Lido.trigger: Perlu dana untuk perluas tim, audit, ekosistem DeFi integration pasca-launch
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-005 Series A; Phase 5 Funding History Series A; Phase 2 Investor entities (Paradigm, a16z, Dragonfly, Variant, Robot Ventures)
Lido.decision: Terima Series A Paradigm lead; investor mendapat kursi di multisig treasury awal; token allocation via SAFT dari pool investor 22.18%
Lido.immediate_result: Treasury DAO diperkuat; percepatan pengembangan V2 dan cross-chain; Paradigm mendapat influence governance via multisig
Lido.long_term_impact: Menetapkan pola investor VC dengan token warrant + multisig seat; valuation jump ke >$1B Series B tahun berikutnya
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Investors, Phase 3 EV-005, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 Distribution (Investors)

Lido.title: Pembentukan Lido DAO Foundation di Cayman Islands
Lido.trigger: Perlu legal wrapper untuk treasury, kontrak, IP, compliance, bank account
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-007 Legal; Phase 2 Foundation (Lido DAO), Government (Cayman Islands); Phase 5 Treasury Custodian; Phase 6 Governance
Lido.decision: irikan Limited Liability Foundation Cayman Islands sebagai legal entity DAO; memegang kontrak protokol, treasury, IP; multisig 5-of-9 execution
Lido.immediate_result: DAO dapat bertindak hukum, sign contracts, buka rekening bank, batasi liability token holder
Lido.long_term_impact: Struktur legal yang memungkinkan DAO beroperasi lama; namun review 2024 mengevaluasi apakah perlu wrapper tambahan (MiCA, SEC)
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Foundation, Government, Phase 3 EV-007, Phase 5 Treasury Custodian, Phase 6 Governance, Phase 3 EV-024

Lido.title: wstETH Deployment di Optimism dan Arbitrum via canonical bridges
Lido.trigger: L2 DeFi berkembang (Aave V3, Velodrome, GMX); butuh non-rebasing token composable
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-010 wstETH L2; Phase 1 Chains (Optimism, Arbitrum); Phase 4 Cross-chain Messaging, Core Components (wstETH); Phase 7 Major Integrations (Optimism, Arbitrum)
Lido.decision: Deploy wstETH via Optimism Gateway dan Arbitrum Bridge (canonical); tidak deploy kontrak staking baru di L2
Lido.immediate_result: wstETH supply L2 tumbuh >500k (2023); menjadi collateral utama DeFi L2
Lido.long_term_impact: Menetapkan strategi "bridge wstETH, bukan deploy staking baru" untuk L2; diulang untuk Base, zkSync Era (EV-012)
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, EV-012, Phase 4 Cross-chain Messaging, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Market Timeline

Lido.title: Lido V2 Mainnet Launch — Staking Router + Withdrawal Credentials 0x01
Lido.trigger: Ethereum Shanghai upgrade (EIP-4895) enable native withdrawals; perlu modular operator onboarding untuk desentralisasi
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-013 V2 Launch, EV-019 Shanghai Readiness; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History V2, Core Components (Staking Router, Withdrawal Queue), Security Model; Phase 7 Infrastructure (Obol, SSV, Simple DVT)
Lido.decision: Activate via governance LIP-14: Staking Router (modular modules), withdrawal credentials 0x01, oracle v2, dynamic node operator registry
Lido.immediate_result: Withdrawal stETH→ETH enabled (burn stETH, claim ETH dari queue); permissionless operator onboarding via modules; siap untuk EigenLayer
Lido.long_term_impact: Arsitektur modular memungkinkan ekspansi operator tanpa upgrade kontrak; withdrawal queue memenuhi janji liquid staking; fondasi untuk restaking
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, EV-019, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Core Components, Security Model, Phase 7 Infrastructure

Lido.title: Sunset Lido on Solana (stSOL), Polkadot (stDOT), Kusama (stKSM)
Lido.trigger: Adoption rendah, biaya operasional tinggi, kompetisi native stake pools (Marinade, Jito), fokus resource ke Ethereum/L2
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-014 Sunset Solana, EV-015 Sunset Polkadot/Kusama; Phase 1 Chains (deprecated); Phase 4 Core Components (deprecated); Phase 7 Major Integrations (deprecated)
Lido.decision: Governance vote menutup produk; redemption window dibuka untuk user exit ke native token; kontrak dihentikan Q4 2023
Lido.immediate_result: TVL stSOL/stDOT/stKSM turun ke ~0; resource tim teralihkan ke Ethereum/L2/EigenLayer
Lido.long_term_impact: Menunjukkan disiplin resource allocation; konsolidasi ke Ethereum alignment; non-EVM chains dibuang
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, EV-009, EV-014, EV-015, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations

Lido.title: Integrasi EigenLayer Restaking — wstETH sebagai LRT dominan
Lido.trigger: EigenLayer launch restaking mainnet; wstETH sudah tersebar luas di DeFi sebagai collateral
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-016 EigenLayer Integration; Phase 2 Protocol (EigenLayer); Phase 4 Architecture (Cross-chain Messaging — native Ethereum); Phase 7 Major Integrations (EigenLayer), External Dependencies (EigenLayer)
Lido.decision: Tidak deploy kontrak baru; wstETH existing langsung accepted sebagai restaking collateral di EigenLayer contracts
Lido.immediate_result: wstETH >50% TVL restaking awal; muncul LRT protocols (ezETH, rsETH, swETH) menggunakan wstETH underlying
Lido.long_term_impact: Memperkuat positioning wstETH sebagai "base layer" DeFi + restaking; Lido tidak perlu mengeluarkan LRT native (berbeda competitor)
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, Phase 2 EigenLayer, Phase 4 Architecture, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Narrative Position (Restaking)

Lido.title: Fee Switch Activation — 10% staking rewards ke treasury via LIP-22
Lido.trigger: Treasury butuh revenue sustainable untuk grants, core contributor budget, insurance; 5% fee (2020-2024) dianggap tidak cukup
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-020 Fee Switch; Phase 5 Revenue Model (Staking Fee 10%), Financial Risk; Phase 6 Governance (LIP-22), Utility (Fee Switch Activation)
Lido.decision: Governance vote meningkatkan protocol fee dari 5% ke 10% rewards; 5% operator + 10% DAO = 15% total fee
Lido.immediate_result: Treasury revenue meningkat signifikan; DAO memperluas grant program dan budget 2024-2025
Lido.long_term_impact: Membuat DAO financially sustainable tanpa bergantung token sale; namun meningkatkan tekanan pada stETH yield vs competitor
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-020, Phase 5 Revenue Model, Financial Risk, Phase 6 Governance, Utility, Phase 8 Market Timeline

Lido.title: Permissionless Node Operator Onboarding via Staking Router Modules
Lido.trigger: Kritik sentralisasi (~28.5% ETH staked); perlu geographic/client diversity; DVT technology matang (Obol, SSV)
Lido.evidence: Phase 3 EV-021 Node Operator Expansion; Phase 4 Core Components (Staking Router), Security Model (Validator Set), Known Limitations; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers (Obol, SSV, Simple DVT); Phase 8 Narrative (Centralization Risk)
Lido.decision: Activate Simple DVT, Obol, SSV modules via governance; onboard 20+ operator baru termasuk solo staker via DVT clusters
Lido.immediate_result: Operator count naik ke 33+ entities + DVT clusters; client diversity diperbaiki; geographic spread meningkat
Lido.long_term_impact: Menjawab narasi sentralisasi; arsitektur modular V2 terbukti works; template untuk future module types
Lido.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, EV-021, Phase 4 Staking Router, Security Model, Known Limitations, Phase 7 Infrastructure, Phase 8 Narrative Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Multi-chain Broad → Ethereum + L2 Focus

Linea.title: Memulai riset internal zkEVM di Consensys
Linea.trigger: Kebutuhan scaling Ethereum yang mempertahankan EVM equivalence dan keamanan L1 via ZK proofs
Linea.evidence: Consensys R&D memulai riset zero-knowledge proof untuk Layer 2 (Phase 1 Foundation)
Linea.decision: Alokasikan tim peneliti ZK dan arsitek Ethereum internal untuk desain arsitektur Vortex prover berbasis PLONK
Linea.immediate_result: Fondasi teknis untuk Linea zkEVM termasuk arsitektur prover dan desain rollup
Linea.long_term_impact: Menjadi basis seluruh stack teknis Linea hingga Type 1 equivalence
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-001; Phase 4 Architecture, Core Components

Linea.title: Finalisasi arsitektur Type 2 zkEVM dengan Vortex prover PLONK
Linea.trigger: Hasil riset 2020 menunjukkan PLONK feasible untuk EVM equivalence praktis
Linea.evidence: Arsitektur finalized: Type 2 zkEVM, Vortex prover PLONK, DA di Ethereum L1, bridge native (Phase 3 EV-002)
Linea.decision: Commit ke Type 2 (bukan Type 1 atau Type 4) sebagai sweet spot launch; Type 1 sebagai target jangka panjang
Linea.immediate_result: Spesifikasi teknis lengkap untuk implementasi testnet
Linea.long_term_impact: Memungkinkan launch mainnet 2023 dengan kompatibilitas EVM tinggi; roadmap Type 1 terealisasi 2024
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-002; Phase 4 Architecture, Execution Environment

Linea.title: Launch private testnet Alpha untuk validator dan mitra awal
Linea.trigger: Arsitektur siap diuji dalam kondisi live dengan beban nyata
Linea.evidence: Private testnet Alpha untuk validator dan mitra ekosistem awal (Phase 3 EV-003)
Linea.decision: Buka akses terbatas untuk menguji prover, sequencer, bridge contracts sebelum public
Linea.immediate_result: Validasi arsitektur prover dan sequencer; umpan balik untuk optimisasi gas · Long-term Result: Mengurangi risiko bug kritis di public testnet dan mainnet

Linea.title: Launch public testnet di Ethereum Goerli
Linea.trigger: Private testnet stabil; butuh stress test skala besar dan onboarding developer
Linea.evidence: Public testnet Goerli terbuka untuk developer dan pengguna umum (Phase 3 EV-004)
Linea.decision: Deploy ke Goerli testnet Ethereum dengan bridge ETH/ERC20 dan tooling lengkap
Linea.immediate_result: >100k wallet unik, >1M transaksi bulan pertama; ekosistem early projects bermigrasi
Linea.long_term_impact: Membangun komunitas developer dan pengguna sebelum mainnet; mengidentifikasi bug skala besar
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-004; Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem, Applications

Linea.title: Menyelesaikan audit komprehensif pre-mainnet dari 3 firma top-tier
Linea.trigger: Kebutuhan kepercayaan institusional dan keamanan before mainnet dengan TVL signifikan
Linea.evidence: Audit Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, Sigma Prime mencakup contracts, circuits, prover (Phase 3 EV-006)
Linea.decision: Invest waktu dan biaya untuk audit berlapis sebelum mainnet; publish laporan transparan
Linea.immediate_result: Semua findings critical/high resolved sebelum mainnet; laporan dipublikasikan
Linea.long_term_impact: Standar keamanan tinggi membangun kepercayaan DeFi protocols untuk deploy; mitigasi exploit awal
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-006; Phase 4 Audit History, Security Model

Linea.title: Mainnet Alpha fair launch tanpa token dan tanpa alokasi VC
Linea.trigger: Teknologi production-ready; ingin menghindari kritik "VC chain" dan membangun kepercayaan komunitas
Linea.evidence: Mainnet Alpha diluncurkan dengan fair launch (no token, no VC allocation) (Phase 3 EV-005)
Linea.decision: Launch mainnet dengan EIP-4844 ready, bridge canonical, 50+ protokol day-one, zero token
Linea.immediate_result: TVL >$20M minggu pertama; >50 protokol live; bridge canonical >$50M volume minggu pertama
Linea.long_term_impact: Reputasi "fair launch" membedakan Linea dari Base, Arbitrum, Optimism; fondasi untuk Voyage points program
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005; Phase 6 Token Information, Distribution; Phase 8 Market Position

Linea.title: Meluncurkan Voyage Season 1 sebagai program insentif berbasis poin (LXP) tanpa token
Linea.trigger: Butuh mendorong adopsi dan likuiditas tanpa token native (pre-TGE)
Linea.evidence: Voyage Season 1 launched dengan sistem poin LXP berbasis aktivitas on-chain (Phase 3 EV-007)
Linea.decision: Gunakan points system (LXP) sebagai proxy untuk future token allocation; reward aktivitas nyata
Linea.immediate_result: >500k wallet unik berpartisipasi; TVL puncak >$400M; >20M transaksi selama season
Linea.long_term_impact: Membuat model "points-to-airdrop" yang ditiru proyek lain; membangun komunitas loyal pre-TGE
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007; Phase 6 Major Token Events; Phase 7 Applications, Voyage Program

Linea.title: Mengintegrasikan 4 lapisan cross-chain messaging sekaligus
Linea.trigger: Ekosistem butuh likuiditas cross-chain; tidak bergantung single bridge
Linea.evidence: LayerZero, Axelar, Wormhole integrated Oktober 2023 (EV-008); Chainlink CCIP November 2023 (EV-009)
Linea.decision: Integrasi resmi 4 protokol messaging terbesar secara paralel; bukan exclusive partnership
Linea.immediate_result: Cross-chain volume >$100M bulan pertama; >20 protokol omnichain deploy; >30 protokol DeFi pakai Chainlink feeds
Linea.long_term_impact: Linea menjadi hub cross-chain paling terhubung di zkEVM; mengurangi risiko single bridge failure
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, EV-009; Phase 7 Major Integrations, External Dependencies

Linea.title: Launch Voyage Season 2 dengan LXP-L untuk liquidity providers
Linea.trigger: Season 1 sukses tapi butuh insentif likuiditas berkelanjutan bukan hanya aktivitas transaksi
Linea.evidence: Voyage Season 2 dengan mekanisme LXP diperluas dan LXP-L untuk likuiditas (Phase 3 EV-010)
Linea.decision: Tambahkan multiplicator untuk LP dan ekosistem DeFi; perpanjang program
Linea.immediate_result: TVL stabil >$300M; >1M active wallets bulanan; >500 protokol terintegrasi
Linea.long_term_impact: Membuktikan points program bisa sustain liquidity bukan hanya hype awal
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010; Phase 6 Major Token Events; Phase 8 Adoption Metrics

Linea.title: Mengaktifkan Boojum prover upgrade (PLONK recursive proving)
Linea.trigger: Biaya proving tinggi dan finality ~3 jam menghambat UX DeFi dan throughput
Linea.evidence: Boojum mengurangi biaya proving ~90% dan finality dari ~3 jam ke ~15 menit (Phase 3 EV-011)
Linea.decision: Deploy recursive proving system yang telah diuji ekstensif di testnet
Linea.immediate_result: Gas fee L2 turun >80%; throughput naik 10x; finality cepat untuk UX DeFi
Linea.long_term_impact: Memungkinkan Linea bersaing dengan optimistic rollup pada finality; fondasi untuk EIP-4844 support
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Prover

Linea.title: Mengaktifkan EIP-4844 blob support segera pasca-Dencun
Linea.trigger: Ethereum Dencun upgrade live; blob transactions menawarkan >90% DA cost reduction
Linea.evidence: Linea aktifkan blob support segera setelah Dencun; median gas L2 <$0.01 (Phase 3 EV-012)
Linea.decision: Prioritaskan engineering resources untuk blob integration day-one; tidak menunggu kompetitor
Linea.immediate_result: Blob utilization >60% minggu pertama; median gas fee L2 <$0.01
Linea.long_term_impact: Linea menjadi salah satu L2 paling efisien biaya; menarik user sensitif gas
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-012; Phase 4 Architecture, Technical Upgrade History

Linea.title: Launch Voyage Season 3 "Surge" dengan focus real usage dan quest platform
Linea.trigger: Musim "airdrop farming" muncul; butuh filter user nyata vs bot/sybil
Linea.evidence: Season 3 Surge dengan Galxe/Zealy quest, anti-sybil, Surge Points untuk DeFi utama (Phase 3 EV-013)
Linea.decision: Pindah dari volume-based ke quality-based rewards; integrasi proof-of-humanity
Linea.immediate_result: TVL puncak >$600M (Maret 2024); >2M active wallets; >50M transaksi bulanan
Linea.long_term_impact: Menetapkan standar anti-sybil untuk points program; data quality untuk airdrop allocation
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013; Phase 6 Major Token Events; Phase 7 Major Integrations

Linea.title: Emergency pause sequencer dan upgrade bridge pasca exploit $6.8M
Linea.trigger: Eksploitasi canonical message service memungkinkan pencurian ~$6.8M via manipulasi proof message
Linea.evidence: Bridge dipause ~48 jam; sequencer restart dengan upgraded contracts; post-mortem published (Phase 3 EV-014)
Linea.decision: Tindakan cepat: pause bridge, halt sequencer, deploy emergency fix, audit tambahan
Linea.immediate_result: Bridge dipause ~48 jam; $6.8M lost (tidak direcover); post-mortem transparan; audit tambahan
Linea.long_term_impact: Meningkatkan kepercayaan via transparansi; hardening bridge contracts; mempengaruhi roadmap decentralization
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-014; Phase 4 Security Model, Technical Upgrade History; Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

Linea.title: Mengumumkan pembentukan Linea Foundation independen
Linea.trigger: Perlu entitas legal non-profit untuk mengelola treasury, grants, governance, decentralisasi post-Consensys
Linea.evidence: Foundation formation announced August 2024 sebagai entitas independen non-profit (Phase 3 EV-016)
Linea.decision: Spin-off dari Consensys ke foundation terpisah (Cayman/BVI typical); kelola ecosystem grants, TGE coordination
Linea.immediate_result: Struktur governance formalisasi; persiapan untuk token/DAO di masa depan
Linea.long_term_impact: Memisahkan pengembangan protokol dari kepentingan korporat Consensys; enabling true DAO governance
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016; Phase 6 Governance; Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem

Linea.title: Mempublikasikan roadmap deskentralisasi prover 3 tahap
Linea.trigger: Prover saat ini fully centralized (Consensys-operated); butuh credible path ke decentralization
Linea.evidence: Roadmap: Phase 1 permissioned provers, Phase 2 proof marketplace, Phase 3 decentralized proving network dengan staking (Phase 3 EV-017)
Linea.decision: Publish detailed technical roadmap dengan timeline 2025; RFP untuk operator eksternal
Linea.immediate_result: Spesifikasi teknis prover network; RFP untuk operator prover eksternal
Linea.long_term_impact: Menetapkan ekspektasi komunitas dan investor; pressure untuk deliver Phase 1 2025
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-017; Phase 4 Security Model, Known Technical Limitations

Linea.title: Mengumumkan Voyage Season 4 sebagai final pre-TGE season dengan anti-sybil ketat
Linea.trigger: TGE mendekat; butuh final snapshot yang fair dan sybil-resistant untuk airdrop allocation
Linea.evidence: Season 4 fokus "real users" dengan anti-sybil ketat, proof-of-humanity, reward berbasis kontribusi nyata (Phase 3 EV-018)
Linea.decision: Desain season paling ketat: proof-of-humanity, Galxe/Zealy integration, no volume farming
Linea.immediate_result: Persiapan komunitas untuk TGE; mekanisme airdrop allocation finalized
Linea.long_term_impact: Menentukan distributio token awal; reputasi fairness critical untuk token launch
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-018; Phase 6 TGE, Distribution, Major Token Events

Linea.title: Mencapai zkEVM Type 1 equivalence di testnet
Linea.trigger: Target teknis jangka panjang sejak 2021; diferensiasi vs Scroll, Polygon zkEVM
Linea.evidence: Type 1 equivalence achieved di testnet: semua opcode, precompiles, block structure identik L1 (Phase 3 EV-019)
Linea.decision: Invest engineering untuk full equivalence; target mainnet Q1 2025
Linea.immediate_result: Developer bisa copy-paste kontrak Ethereum tanpa modifikasi; tooling 100% kompatibel
Linea.long_term_impact: Menghapus hambatan migrasi dari Ethereum L1; posisi teknis terkuat di kategori zkEVM
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-019; Phase 4 Execution Environment, Technical Upgrade History

Linea.title: Merencanakan TGE dan DAO launch Q1 2025
Linea.trigger: Semua prasyarat terpenuhi: foundation, roadmap decentralization, Type 1 equivalence, Voyage 4 seasons
Linea.evidence: TGE dengan allocation: Voyage participants, ecosystem grants, foundation, core contributors, investor (Phase 3 EV-020)
Linea.decision: Fair launch token via airdrop (no public sale); DAO governance aktif bersamaan; staking untuk prover decentralization
Linea.immediate_result: Token live; governance proposals aktif; staking untuk prover decentralization dimulai
Linea.long_term_impact: Transisi dari Consensys-controlled ke community-governed; value accrual ke token holders
Linea.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-020; Phase 6 Token Information, Distribution, Vesting, Governance; Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Consensys internal project" ke "Independent Foundation-governed Protocol" · Fase 2020-2023: Linea dikembangkan sepenuhnya internal Consensys R&D; funding, staffing, decision-making semua Consensys (EV-001, EV-002, EV-003, EV-004, EV-005) · Fase 2024: Pembentukan Linea Foundation (EV-016) memisahkan governance dari Consensys; Foundation mengelola treasury, grants, TGE coordination · Fase 2025 (target): DAO launch mengalihkan kekuasaan ke token holders; Consensys menjadi core contributor biasa

MakerDAO.title: Launch Single Collateral Dai (Sai) di Ethereum Mainnet
MakerDAO.trigger: Butuh validasi produksi konsep CDP stablecoin setelah testnet internal 2015-2016 (EV-003)
MakerDAO.evidence: Maker Blog MCD Launch reference to Sai history (HIGH) [https://blog.makerdao.com/multi-collateral-dai-has-launched/]
MakerDAO.decision: Deploy Sai (DAI v1) dengan ETH sebagai collateral tunggal; MKR untuk governance parameter
MakerDAO.immediate_result: Protokol live; Sai bersirkulasi; MKR digunakan governance
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Membuktikan CDP model on-chain; fondasi untuk MCD multi-collateral 2019
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005; Phase 1 Launch Date Mainnet

MakerDAO.title: Migrasi ke Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) dan launch DSR
MakerDAO.trigger: Keterbatasan collateral ETH tunggal membatasi skala dan diversifikasi risiko
MakerDAO.decision: Deploy MCD dengan support multi-collateral (ETH, BAT, dll.), DAI baru kontrak 0x6B17..., DSR module, PSM-ready architecture
MakerDAO.immediate_result: Protokol mendukung multi-collateral; DSR live 2019-11 (EV-008); Sai migrasi ke DAI baru
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Membuka pintu RWA Vaults 2022; PSM launch 2020; DAI supply scaling ke $5B+
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007, EV-008; Phase 4 Technology Core Components Vat, Jug, Pot, PSM

MakerDAO.title: Emergency response Black Thursday — MKR dilution via Flop auction
MakerDAO.trigger: ETH crash >50% dalam jam, oracle latency, 0-bid liquidations → system deficit ~$5.3M DAI (EV-009)
MakerDAO.evidence: Maker Blog State of Protocol March 2020 (HIGH) [https://blog.makerdao.com/state-of-the-protocol-march-2020/]
MakerDAO.decision: Emergency spell mint ~50,000 MKR baru via Flop auction, jual untuk DAI tutup deficit; OSM delay diperpanjang; parameter likuidasi diperketat
MakerDAO.immediate_result: Defisit tertutup; sistem survive; MKR supply naik sementara dari ~1M ke ~1.05M
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Liquidation 2.0 (Dutch auction dengan kicker) 2020-08 (EV-008 timeline); OSM hardening; PIVOT oracle upgrade 2023; risk framework strengthened
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-009, EV-010 (Liquidation 2.0 context); Phase 4 Technology Security Model, Audit History Sigma Prime 2020-06

MakerDAO.title: Launch Peg Stability Module (PSM) USDC-A
MakerDAO.trigger: Butuh mekanisme peg defense efisien beyond Vault arbitration; DAI sering trade >$1
MakerDAO.decision: Deploy PSM sebagai Vault type USDC-A dengan fee 0%, LR 101%, mint/redeem 1:1 DAI↔USDC
MakerDAO.immediate_result: Peg stabil di $1; arbitrase efisien; PSM jadi tulang punggung peg
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: PSM expanded ke USDT-A, GUSD-A, USDP-A; >60% DAI supply backed PSM 2024 (EV-021); centralization risk jadi topik governance berkelanjutan
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, EV-021; Phase 4 Technology PSM; Phase 5 Financial Risk PSM Concentration; Phase 8 Market Share DAI

MakerDAO.title: Pembubaran Maker Foundation dan transisi ke DAO penuh
MakerDAO.trigger: Rencana desentralisasi bertahap; Foundation sudah selesai tugas incubation
MakerDAO.decision: Foundation dissolved; all assets, domains, trademarks, operational responsibility transferred to MKR-governed DAO; Core Units budget on-chain
MakerDAO.immediate_result: DAO mandiri; tidak ada entitas sentral kontrol protokol; Core Units pertama formed (EV-012)
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Governance fully on-chain; legal wrapper needed (Cayman Foundation 2022); SubDAO model enabled (Spark 2023, Sky 2024)
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011, EV-012; Phase 2 Entity Maker Foundation, MakerDAO DAO, Core Units; Phase 4 Technology Governance Layer

MakerDAO.title: Pendirian MakerDAO Cayman Foundation sebagai legal wrapper
MakerDAO.trigger: DAO butuh identitas hukum untuk kontrak, bank account, liability protection, RWA off-chain
MakerDAO.decision: Establish Cayman Foundation sebagai wrapper hukum DAO
MakerDAO.immediate_result: DAO dapat sign kontrak, hold off-chain assets, protect contributors
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Enabled RWA Vaults dengan custodian Coinbase Prime; legal structure untuk SubDAO entities
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013; Phase 2 Entity MakerDAO Cayman Foundation; Phase 5 Financial Dependencies RWA

MakerDAO.title: Launch RWA Vaults dengan BlockTower & Monetalis
MakerDAO.trigger: Diversifikasi yield beyond crypto collateral; tradfi yield lebih stabil; skalakan DAI supply
MakerDAO.decision: Deploy Vault RWA-001 (BlockTower Andromeda - US Treasuries) dan RWA-002 (Monetalis Clydesdale - structured credit) dengan Coinbase Prime custody
MakerDAO.immediate_result: DAI backed by Treasury bills; tradfi yield masuk sistem
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: RWA jadi revenue contributor terbesar >$1B AUM 2024 (EV-022); Endgame SubDAO RWA specialization; dependency pada tradfi counterparties
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-014, EV-022; Phase 2 Entity BlockTower, Monetalis, Coinbase Prime; Phase 5 Revenue Model RWA Yield, Financial Dependencies; Phase 8 Narrative RWA

MakerDAO.title: Ekspansi multi-chain canonical deployments
MakerDAO.trigger: Ethereum gas fees tinggi; user demand di L2; komposabilitas DeFi multi-chain
MakerDAO.decision: Governance spells approve deploy DAI, MKR, Bridge contracts ke Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Gnosis Chain via Canonical Bridge
MakerDAO.immediate_result: DAI/MKR native di 4 chain non-Ethereum; bridge.makerdao.com live
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Base & Starknet 2023-2024 (EV-018); cross-chain liquidity; bridge finality challenges (7-day challenge periods)
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-015, EV-018; Phase 4 Technology Secondary Layers, Canonical Bridge; Phase 2 Entity 6 chains; Phase 7 Infrastructure Providers

MakerDAO.title: Launch Spark Protocol sebagai SubDAO pertama
MakerDAO.trigger: Butuh specialized lending/liquidity layer; sDAI untuk yield-bearing DAI; fee flow ke Maker Treasury
MakerDAO.decision: Deploy SparkLend, sDAI (ERC-4626 wrapper DSR), SubDAO fee sharing agreement
MakerDAO.immediate_result: sDAI ~$1.2B supply 2024; Spark revenue sharing ke Maker; SubDAO model validated
MakerDAO.long_term_impact: Template untuk SubDAO masa depan; Endgame plan multiple SubDAOs; internal competition dengan Oasis/Sky.money
MakerDAO.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016; Phase 2 Entity Spark Protocol; Phase 7 Major Integrations Spark; Phase 8 Competitor Landscape Internal

Movement Labs.title: Mengembangkan MEVM (Move-EVM compatibility layer) sebagai fitur inti
Movement Labs.trigger: Kebutuhan menarik Ethereum developer dan dApps existing tanpa rewrite; kompetisi L2 yang sudah EVM-equivalent (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)
Movement Labs.evidence: Parthenon testnet launch (EV-009) memprioritaskan MEVM testing; blog testnet announcement menekankan Hardhat/Foundry support dan Solidity deployment tanpa modifikasi
Movement Labs.decision: Build transpiler/compiler EVM bytecode → Move bytecode dengan precompile support; bukan EVM-equivalent tapi EVM-compatible
Movement Labs.immediate_result: Developer dapat deploy Solidity contracts di testnet Parthenon menggunakan tooling familiar
Movement Labs.long_term_impact: Differentiator vs Move L1 (Aptos/Sui tidak EVM-compatible); trade-off: kompatibilitas tidak 100% (precompiles, opcode, gas semantics gaps)
Movement Labs.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-009, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Phase 7 Major Integrations (MEVM↔Hardhat/Foundry - Live), Phase 8 Competitor Landscape (vs Arbitrum/Optimism/Base EVM-equivalent)

Optimism.evidence: OP Labs Series B unicorn valuation (Phase 3 EV-027; Phase 5 Funding History, Financial Dependencies)
Optimism.decision: Terima VC funding besar dengan valuation tinggi; Paradigm & a16z lead
Optimism.immediate_result: Treasury OP Labs diperkuat untuk roadmap Superchain
Optimism.long_term_impact: Financial runway untuk multi-year development; investor alignment dengan vision; Paradigm/a16z strategic guidance
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-027, Phase 5 Funding History, Financial Dependencies

Optimism.title: Base launch oleh Coinbase sebagai OP Stack chain pertama
Optimism.trigger: Coinbase ingin L2 sendiri; Optimism butuh validasi OP Stack oleh major player
Optimism.evidence: Base mainnet launch; Coinbase Series A investor OP Labs; revenue sharing model (Phase 3 EV-013; Phase 2 Company Coinbase, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Optimism.decision: Support Coinbase deploy OP Stack chain dengan branding terpisah (Base) tapi shared codebase
Optimism.immediate_result: Base live, Superchain concept mulai terealisasi dengan chain kedua
Optimism.long_term_impact: Base jadi OP Stack chain terbesar by TVL/users; validasi OP Stack sebagai framework; Coinbase jadi strategic partner bukan competitor
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Competitor Landscape

Optimism.title: Superchain concept announced resmi
Optimism.trigger: Multiple OP Stack chains live (OP Mainnet, Base, Zora); butuh vision untuk interoperabilitas
Optimism.evidence: Superchain vision: jaringan chain interoperabel shared security, governance, bridge (Phase 3 EV-014; Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 7 Ecosystem Position)
Optimism.decision: Publish konsep Superchain sebagai north star untuk ekosistem
Optimism.immediate_result: Framework konseptual untuk jaringan L2 terfederasi diterbitkan
Optimism.long_term_impact: Menarik 30+ team deploy OP Stack chain; Granite upgrade building technical foundation; narrative differentiation vs single-chain L2
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-014, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Narrative Position

Optimism.title: Canyon upgrade — EIP-1559 fee market
Optimism.trigger: Butuh fee market yang predictable; EIP-1559 standard di Ethereum L1
Optimism.evidence: Canyon mengaktifkan EIP-1559 di OP Mainnet; base fee burned, priority fee ke sequencer (Phase 3 EV-018; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Execution Environment)
Optimism.decision: Implement EIP-1559 di L2 dengan base fee burn (ETH, bukan OP)
Optimism.immediate_result: Fee market lebih prediktif; ETH burn mechanism live · Long-term Result: Alignment dengan Ethereum UX; revenue model shift dari gas auction ke priority fee; OP token tidak used untuk gas
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-018, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 6 Utility

Optimism.title: Ecotone/Fjord upgrades — EIP-4844 blob support
Optimism.trigger: Ethereum Dencun upgrade membawa blob transactions; butuh reduce L1 DA cost >90%
Optimism.evidence: Ecotone: EIP-4844 support; Fjord: full blob submission via batcher (Phase 3 EV-019, EV-022; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Architecture)
Optimism.decision: Upgrade bertahap untuk support blobs — Ecotone dulu (consensus), Fjord (batcher integration)
Optimism.immediate_result: Blob transactions supported; L1 data posting cost turun drastis
Optimism.long_term_impact: Sequencer profitability meningkat drastis; OP Mainnet cost-competitive vs alt-L1; enabling high-throughput use cases
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-019, EV-022, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Architecture

Optimism.title: Granite upgrade — Interop messaging dan shared sequencing foundation
Optimism.trigger: Superchain butuh native interoperability; centralized sequencer butuh decentralization path
Optimism.evidence: Granite: interop messaging antar OP Stack chains, shared sequencing foundation, fault proof improvements (Phase 3 EV-028; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Known Limitations)
Optimism.decision: Build native cross-chain messaging dan shared sequencing sebagai single upgrade
Optimism.immediate_result: Fondasi interoperabilitas Superchain mulai dibangun di testnet
Optimism.long_term_impact: Jika sukses, Superchain jadi first truly interoperable L2 network; shared sequencing solves centralized sequencer risk
Optimism.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-028, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Known Limitations Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Single Chain ke Modular Framework ke Interoperable Network · Phase 1-2 (2019-2022): Fokus single chain (OP Mainnet) sebagai Optimistic Rollup L2 — Plasma Group → Optimism Foundation → OP Mainnet launch → Token launch → Governance · Phase 3 (2023): Pivot ke modular framework — Bedrock upgrade → OP Stack v0.1.0 release → Base launch → Superchain concept announced · Phase 4 (2024): Eksekusi Superchain vision — Multiple chain launches (World Chain, Fraxtal) → Ecotone/Fjord (EIP-4844) → Granite (interop) planned → Superchain Registry 30+ chains

Polkadot.title: Publikasi Whitepaper Polkadot
Polkadot.trigger: Gavin Wood mengusulkan arsitektur multi-chain heterogeneous setelah meninggalkan Ethereum; kebutuhan interoperabilitas dan shared security tidak terpenuhi oleh arsitektur single-chain
Polkadot.evidence: Whitepaper Polkadot 2016 mengusulkan Relay Chain + parachains + shared security (Phase 3 EV-001)
Polkadot.decision: Menerbitkan whitepaper sebagai fondasi teknis dan visi arsitektur
Polkadot.immediate_result: Dasar teknis untuk pendirian Web3 Foundation dan pengembangan Substrate
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Menjadi blueprint arsitektur seluruh ekosistem Polkadot hingga JAM

Polkadot.title: Pendirian Web3 Foundation di Zug, Swiss
Polkadot.trigger: Butuh entitas hukum nirlaba untuk mengelola treasury ICO, grant, dan stewardship protokol
Polkadot.evidence: Web3 Foundation didirikan 2017 di Zug (Phase 3 EV-002); mengelola grant >$100M dan Decentralized Futures $20M (Phase 5 Funding History)
Polkadot.decision: Membentuk yayasan Swiss sebagai legal wrapper dan treasury custodian
Polkadot.immediate_result: Entitas hukum untuk token sale, grant program, trademark holder
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Pusat keputusan off-chain (treasury, grant, strategi) terkonsentrasi di satu entitas Swiss

Polkadot.title: Polkadot ICO Public Sale
Polkadot.trigger: Butuh dana pengembangan ~$145M; pilihan public sale tanpa private sale/VC token allocation
Polkadot.evidence: ICO mengumpulkan 144,640.65 ETH dari 5,500+ kontributor, cap 20 ETH/kontributor (Phase 3 EV-003; Phase 5 Token Sale)
Polkadot.decision: Public sale tunggal, fair launch, tanpa whitelist/KYC di bawah cap
Polkadot.immediate_result: Dana ~$145M terkumpul; 66% dana terkunci akibat Parity hack Nov 2017 (EV-004)
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Distribusi token awal ke komunitas luas; tidak ada investor VC dengan token allocation — beda dengan proyek lain
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-003, EV-004, Phase 5 Token Sale, Phase 5 Funding History

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran Substrate Framework
Polkadot.trigger: Butuh framework modular untuk membangun Relay Chain, parachains, dan chain mandiri secara efisien
Polkadot.evidence: Substrate dirilis 2018 oleh Parity Technologies (Phase 3 EV-005); menjadi fondasi Polkadot, Kusama, ratusan chain lain (Phase 4 Core Components)
Polkadot.decision: Membangun dan open-source Substrate sebagai framework pembangun chain
Polkadot.immediate_result: Mempercepat pengembangan Polkadot Relay Chain; menarik developer eksternal
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Substrate menjadi de facto standard untuk app-chain di ekosistem Polkadot; Polkadot SDK v1.0 (EV-021) mengonsolidasikan stack
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-005, EV-021, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 4 Development Framework

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran Kusama sebagai Canary Network
Polkadot.trigger: Butuh lingkungan produksi dengan nilai ekonomi nyata untuk menguji fitur sebelum deploy ke Polkadot
Polkadot.evidence: Kusama mainnet genesis EV-008; "canary network" dengan token bernilai ekonomis (Phase 3 EV-008; Phase 4 System Architecture)
Polkadot.decision: Meluncurkan jaringan terpisah (bukan testnet) dengan ekonomi nyata sebagai staging ground
Polkadot.immediate_result: Validasi staking, governance, parachain, XCM di produksi sebelum Polkadot
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Model "canary network" menjadi referensi industri; parachain pertama (Karura, Moonriver, Shiden) debut di Kusama
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 System Architecture, Phase 7 Major Integrations

Polkadot.title: Mainnet Genesis Polkadot Relay Chain
Polkadot.trigger: Substrate, Kusama, testnet (PoC-3/4/5) sudah matang; siap produksi
Polkadot.evidence: Genesis block EV-010; mode Proof-of-Authority awal dikelola Web3 Foundation (Phase 3 EV-010)
Polkadot.decision: Meluncurkan mainnet dengan PoA sementara, transisi ke NPoS kemudian
Polkadot.immediate_result: Relay Chain live, DOT native token aktif, transfer disabled
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Fondasi seluruh ekosistem parachain, staking, governance, XCM

Polkadot.title: Transisi ke NPoS & Validasi Komunitas
Polkadot.trigger: Desentralisasi validasi dari Web3 Foundation ke komunitas
Polkadot.evidence: EV-011 mengaktifkan NPoS, validator dipilih via nominasi, governance on-chain diaktifkan (Phase 3 EV-011)
Polkadot.decision: Beralih dari PoA ke NPoS dengan validator set komunitas
Polkadot.immediate_result: Validator komunitas memproduksi blok; inflasi staking reward mulai berjalan
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Keamanan jaringan didistribusikan ke ~297 validator + ~25-30k nominator; model ekonomi staking aktif

Polkadot.title: Redenomination DOT 1:100
Polkadot.trigger: Supply 10M DOT (0 decimals) tidak praktis untuk UX, granularitas fee, dan perhitungan staking
Polkadot.evidence: Referendum melewatkan redenom 1 DOT lama = 100 DOT baru, supply 10M → 1B (Phase 3 EV-012; Phase 6 Token Information)
Polkadot.immediate_result: Supply 1B DOT, harga per token turun ~100x, proporsi kepemilikan tidak berubah
Polkadot.long_term_impact: UX token diperbaiki; decimals 10 standar; tidak ada dampak ekonomi fundamental

Polkadot.title: Aktivasi Transfer DOT & Governance Penuh
Polkadot.trigger: Network stabil, komunitas siap untuk governance mandiri
Polkadot.evidence: Transfer diaktifkan via referendum; governance penuh (referenda, council, tech committee) beroperasi (Phase 3 EV-013)
Polkadot.decision: Membuka transfer token dan mengaktifkan governance on-chain penuh
Polkadot.immediate_result: DOT fully liquid; governance v1 (Council + Technical Committee) live
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Mulai era governance komunitas; Council kemudian diganti OpenGov (EV-020)

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran Parachain Slot Auction
Polkadot.trigger: Relay Chain stabil, XCM/HRMP siap, komunitas parachain siap onboarding
Polkadot.evidence: Slot auction pertama di Polkadot EV-016; candle auction mechanism; Acala menang slot pertama (Phase 3 EV-016)
Polkadot.decision: Mengaktifkan mekanisme parachain slot auction berbasis candle auction
Polkadot.immediate_result: 5 parachain pertama live (EV-017); DOT bonding untuk slot mulai beroperasi
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Model ekonomi blockspace terbentuk; kemudian diganti Agile Coretime (EV-024)
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017, Phase 6 Utility (Parachain Bonding)

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran XCM v2
Polkadot.trigger: Parachain live tapi belum bisa komunikasi cross-chain native
Polkadot.evidence: XCM v2 mengaktifkan asset transfer, remote execution, programmable cross-chain (Phase 3 EV-018; Phase 4 Core Components)
Polkadot.decision: Merilis XCM v2 sebagai standar cross-consensus messaging lengkap
Polkadot.immediate_result: Interoperabilitas native antar parachain aktif; fondasi DeFi cross-chain
Polkadot.long_term_impact: XCM v3 (EV-025) memperluas ke programmable transfers, remote locking, fee abstraction
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-018, EV-025, Phase 4 Core Components

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran OpenGov (Governance v2)
Polkadot.trigger: Governance v1 (Council + Technical Committee) dikritik terlalu terpusat; butuh desentralisasi penuh
Polkadot.evidence: OpenGov menggantikan Council dengan referenda langsung, tracks, conviction voting, delegation (Phase 3 EV-020; Phase 6 Governance)
Polkadot.decision: Migrasi ke sistem referenda langsung tanpa Council
Polkadot.immediate_result: Siapa pun bisa ajukan proposal; delegation per track; treasury spends via referendum
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Governance lebih terdesentralisasi; tapi kompleksitas partisipasi meningkat

Polkadot.title: Rilis Polkadot SDK v1.0
Polkadot.trigger: Repositori terpisah (Substrate, FRAME, Cumulus) mempersulit developer experience dan koordinasi rilis
Polkadot.evidence: SDK v1.0 menggabungkan Substrate, FRAME, Cumulus, tooling ke repo tunggal (Phase 3 EV-021; Phase 4 Development Framework)
Polkadot.decision: Mengonsolidasikan stack development ke Polkadot SDK monorepo

Polkadot.title: Aktivasi Asynchronous Backing
Polkadot.trigger: Throughput parachain terbatas (~1000-1500 TPS teoritis); butuh scaling tanpa mengorbankan keamanan
Polkadot.evidence: Async backing memungkinkan validator mempersiapkan blok berikutnya sebelum finality, throughput naik 2-8x (Phase 3 EV-023; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History)
Polkadot.decision: Mengaktifkan asynchronous backing di Relay Chain
Polkadot.immediate_result: Throughput parachain meningkat signifikan; latency blok turun
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Kapasitas ekosistem diperluas; fondasi untuk scaling lebih lanjut (JAM)
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-023, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History

Polkadot.title: Peluncuran Agile Coretime
Polkadot.trigger: Slot auction model (bonding 6-24 bulan) menciptakan barrier to entry tinggi; butuh fleksibilitas blockspace
Polkadot.evidence: Coretime dijual bulk 28 hari via lelang + on-demand; parachain tidak lagi terkunci slot lama (Phase 3 EV-022, EV-024; Phase 8 Narrative Position)
Polkadot.decision: Migrasi dari slot auction tetap ke marketplace coretime
Polkadot.immediate_result: Barrier to entry parachain turun; pasar coretime sekunder muncul; revenue treasury dari coretime sales
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Blockspace sebagai komoditas; naratif "Chain Abstraction" berkembang
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-022, EV-024, Phase 8 Narrative Position

Polkadot.title: Publikasi JAM Gray Paper
Polkadot.trigger: Arsitektur Relay Chain + parachain memiliki batasan (permissioned parachain, fixed validator set); butuh generasi berikutnya
Polkadot.evidence: JAM Gray Paper mengusulkan permissionless, in-core execution, general-purpose compute (Phase 3 EV-026; Phase 8 Narrative Position)
Polkadot.immediate_result: Riset dan spesifikasi baru; implementasi testnet dimulai (EV-027)
Polkadot.long_term_impact: Potensi migrasi fundamental arsitektur; belum ada migration path resmi
Polkadot.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-026, EV-027, Phase 8 Narrative Position Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Parachain Platform" ke "Blockspace Marketplace" ke "General-Purpose Compute (JAM)"

Polygon.title: IEO Token MATIC di Binance Launchpad
Polygon.trigger: Butuh pendanaan awal dan distribusi token ke publik serta listing exchange utama untuk likuiditas
Polygon.evidence: IEO mengumpulkan $5M dengan harga $0.00263 per MATIC, 1.9B token (19% supply) dijual ke publik via Binance Launchpad (Phase 3 EV-004, EV-005, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 TGE)
Polygon.decision: Melakukan Initial Exchange Offering di Binance Launchpad sebagai public sale pertama
Polygon.immediate_result: Token MATIC terdaftar di Binance segera setelah IEO, dana pengembangan terkumpul, distribusi publik 19% supply
Polygon.long_term_impact: Menetapkan Binance sebagai partner exchange utama; struktur distribusi token awal (19% IEO, 38% investor, 16% team, 22% foundation, 23% community) membentuk holder distribution hingga sekarang
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-004, EV-005, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 TGE, Distribution

Polygon.title: Rebrand Matic Network menjadi Polygon
Polygon.trigger: Visi perluas dari single sidechain Plasma ke multi-chain scaling ecosystem untuk Ethereum
Polygon.evidence: Pengumuman rebrand Februari 2021 mencerminkan perluasan visi; Polygon SDK dirilis Maret 2021 untuk app-chains (Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017, Phase 1 Category)
Polygon.decision: Ganti nama proyek dari Matic Network ke Polygon, memperluas scope produk
Polygon.immediate_result: Brand baru "Polygon" sebagai "Internet of Blockchains" untuk Ethereum; token symbol tetap MATIC
Polygon.long_term_impact: Memposisikan Polygon sebagai ekosistem multi-chain bukan single sidechain; membuka jalan untuk zkEVM, CDK, AggLayer, Miden sebagai produk terpisah tapi terintegrasi
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017, Phase 1 Category, Phase 4 System Architecture

Polygon.title: Akuisisi Hermez Network untuk zkEVM
Polygon.trigger: Butuh teknologi ZK rollup dan tim berpengalaman untuk bersaing di narrative ZK scaling
Polygon.evidence: Polygon mengakuisisi Hermez Network, tim Hermez bergabung mengembangkan zkEVM (Phase 3 EV-020, Phase 2 Protocol Entities, Phase 4 Core Components)
Polygon.decision: Beli Hermez Network dan mengintegrasikan tim serta teknologi ZK-nya ke Polygon
Polygon.immediate_result: Tim Hermez (sekarang 0xPolygonHermez org) memimpin pengembangan Polygon zkEVM
Polygon.long_term_impact: Polygon zkEVM mainnet beta 2023; menjadi pilar Polygon 2.0; akuisisi ini menentukan arah teknologi ZK Polygon selama 3+ tahun
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-020, Phase 2 Protocol Entities, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History

Polygon.title: $450M Strategic Funding Round
Polygon.trigger: Butuh modal besar untuk ekspansi tim, pengembangan produk (zkEVM, CDK, Avail, ID), dan ekosistem
Polygon.evidence: Round dipimpin Sequoia Capital India, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Galaxy Digital; valuasi $13B (Phase 3 EV-026, Phase 5 Funding History)
Polygon.decision: Terima strategic investment dari VC tier-1 dengan alokasi token vesting 12-18 bulan
Polygon.immediate_result: Treasury bertambah $450M; investor strategis bergabung; valuasi $13B
Polygon.long_term_impact: Memungkinkan hiring 400+ karyawan; percepat pengembangan zkEVM, CDK, Avail, ID; menciptakan tekanan unlock token investor 2023-2024
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-026, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 Vesting Schedule, Distribution

Polygon.title: Rilis Polygon CDK Public
Polygon.trigger: Butuh framework standar untuk app-chains agar ekosistem berkembang modular; replace Polygon Edge
Polygon.evidence: CDK dirilis publik 2023; mendukung rollup, validium, sovereign; terintegrasi AggLayer (Phase 3 EV-037, EV-043, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem)
Polygon.decision: Buka CDK untuk developer publik dengan tooling lengkap (CLI, node, contracts, deployment scripts)
Polygon.immediate_result: GameSwift Chain live production 2024 menggunakan CDK; Immutable zkEVM dibangun di atas CDK
Polygon.long_term_impact: CDK menjadi fondasi app-chain ecosystem Polygon; revenue model RaaS via Gelato; POL mandatory gas token untuk semua CDK chains (roadmap 2027)
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-037, EV-043, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Developer Ecosystem, Applications

Polygon.title: Peluncuran Polygon zkEVM Mainnet Beta
Polygon.trigger: Teknologi ZK rollup siap production setelah testnet publik 2022; butuh first-mover advantage di ZK EVM-equivalent
Polygon.evidence: zkEVM mainnet beta live di Ethereum mainnet March 2023; Type 2/3 EVM-equivalent (Phase 3 EV-038, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 4 Execution Environment)
Polygon.decision: Luncurkan zkEVM mainnet beta meski masih centralized sequencer
Polygon.immediate_result: ZK rollup EVM-equivalent pertama live di Ethereum; menarik Aave, Curve deploy 2024
Polygon.long_term_impact: Menetapkan Polygon sebagai pemimpin ZK EVM-equivalent; teknologi prover menjadi basis untuk CDK rollup mode dan AggLayer pessimistic proofs
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-038, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Phase 7 Major Integrations

Polygon.title: Peluncuran AggLayer Testnet
Polygon.trigger: Butuh lapisan interoperabilitas terpadu untuk menyatukan likuiditas PoS, zkEVM, CDK chains
Polygon.evidence: AggLayer testnet dengan pessimistic proofs untuk unified bridging (Phase 3 EV-044, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Polygon.decision: Bangun unified bridge layer dengan pessimistic proofs bukan optimistic/interop tradisional
Polygon.immediate_result: Testnet menghubungkan chain internal; mainnet beta 2024 menghubungkan PoS dan zkEVM
Polygon.long_term_impact: Arsitektur interop Polygon 2.0; potential standar cross-chain untuk ekosistem Ethereum luas; unified liquidity narrative
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-044, EV-047, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations

Polygon.title: Migrasi Token MATIC ke POL
Polygon.trigger: Tokenomics MATIC tidak mendukung multi-chain ecosystem (hanya PoS gas/staking); butuh token universal untuk Polygon 2.0
Polygon.evidence: POL tokenomics diumumkan 2023; migrasi 1:1 dimulai 2024; POL menjadi gas PoS, zkEVM, CDK; emisi 2% staking + 1% treasury (Phase 3 EV-042, EV-046, Phase 6 Token Information, Utility, Inflation)
Polygon.decision: Ganti token native dari MATIC ke POL dengan supply dynamic dan emisi protokol
Polygon.immediate_result: POL listing di 8 major CEX September 2024; dual token period MATIC/POL; staking migrasi ke POL
Polygon.long_term_impact: Tokenomics baru mendukung governance dua kamar, community treasury, shared security CDK; MATIC legacy contracts tetap ada di Ethereum
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-042, EV-046, EV-054, Phase 6 Token Information, Utility, Inflation, Major Token Events

Polygon.title: AggLayer Mainnet Beta
Polygon.trigger: Testnet AggLayer stabil; butuh production validation untuk unified bridging PoS ↔ zkEVM
Polygon.evidence: AggLayer mainnet beta menghubungkan Polygon PoS dan zkEVM dengan pessimistic proofs (Phase 3 EV-047, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Polygon.decision: Luncurkan mainnet beta dengan chain terbatas (PoS, zkEVM) sebelum CDK chains
Polygon.immediate_result: Cross-chain bridging live antara PoS dan zkEVM; unified liquidity mulai terbentuk
Polygon.long_term_impact: Validasi arsitektur pessimistic proofs; fondasi untuk CDK chains onboarding ke AggLayer 2025+
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-047, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations

Polygon.title: Polygon Miden Mainnet Beta
Polygon.trigger: STARK-based rollup development selesai tahap devnet; butuh differentiator privacy/client-side proving
Polygon.evidence: Miden mainnet beta 2025; Miden VM custom STARK-based, non-EVM, client-side proving (Phase 3 EV-058, Phase 4 System Architecture, Execution Environment)
Polygon.decision: Luncurkan Miden sebagai rollup ke-4 (selain PoS, zkEVM, CDK chains) dengan VM sendiri
Polygon.immediate_result: STARK rollup live untuk aplikasi privacy-preserving; tooling minimal, non-EVM
Polygon.long_term_impact: Memperluas addressable market ke use case privacy, DePIN, enterprise yang butuh client-side proving; diversifikasi teknologi beyond EVM
Polygon.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-058, Phase 4 System Architecture, Execution Environment, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Single Sidechain ke Multi-Chain Ecosystem (2017-2021) · Phase 3 EV-001 sampai EV-016: Matic Network mulai sebagai Plasma sidechain single-chain (2017 whitepaper, 2020 mainnet). Rebrand Februari 2021 (EV-016) menandai shift ke visi "Internet of Blockchains" — Polygon SDK (EV-017), Polygon Studios (EV-022), akuisisi Hermez (EV-020) semua dalam 2021 memperluas scope jauh melampaui sidechain asli.

Polymarket.title: Pendirian Polymarket Inc. dan protokol Polymarket
Polymarket.trigger: Identifikasi peluang pasar prediksi terdesentralisasi on-chain dengan UX yang lebih baik dari Augur v1
Polymarket.evidence: Blog peluncuran "Introducing Polymarket" Oktober 2020 menyebut visi founding (Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 3 EV-001)
Polymarket.decision: Mendirikan Delaware corporation, mengembangkan smart contract berbasis CTF Gnosis, CLOB proprietary, integrasi UMA Oracle
Polymarket.immediate_result: Entitas legal dan protokol terbentuk; pengembangan dimulai
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Menjadi fondasi seluruh ekosistem Polymarket hingga 2024
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 2 Entity (Shayne Coplan, Polymarket Inc.), Phase 3 EV-001

Polymarket.title: Integrasi UMA Optimistic Oracle untuk resolusi pasar
Polymarket.trigger: Butuh mekanisme resolusi terdesentralisasi, trust-minimized untuk hasil pasar biner/kategorikal
Polymarket.evidence: Docs teknis menjelaskan UMA integration sebagai komponen kritis (Phase 3 EV-003, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
Polymarket.decision: Mengadopsi UMA Optimistic Oracle (proposer/challenger + eskalasi tokenholder UMA)
Polymarket.immediate_result: Resolusi pasar berfungsi tanpa trusted central party
Polymarket.long_term_impact: Ketergantungan kritis pada UMA; risiko oracle menjadi single point of failure resolusi
Polymarket.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-003, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

Polymarket.title: Mainnet Launch di Polygon
Polymarket.trigger: Kebutuhan execution environment murah dan cepat untuk high-frequency trading prediksi; Ethereum L1 gas terlalu mahal
Polymarket.evidence: Blog peluncuran menyebut Polygon sebagai chain utama (Phase 3 EV-002, Phase 4 System Architecture)
Polymarket.decision: Deploy kontrak inti, CLOB, UMA integration ke Polygon mainnet
Polymarket.immediate_result: Pasar prediksi live on-chain dengan USDC collateral; biaya transaksi rendah

Pump.fun.title: Deploy bonding curve program di Solana mainnet

Pump.fun.evidence: Program deployment di 6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P (Phase 3 EV-001); SolanaFM deployment timestamp (Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History)

Pump.fun.long_term_impact: Menjadi launchpad dominan Solana (~80-90% market share); fondasi untuk multi-chain expansion dan PumpSwap

Pump.fun.immediate_result: Token bonding curve dapat di-swap via Jupiter UI/API; liquidity dan price discovery diperbaiki
Pump.fun.long_term_impact: Jupiter menjadi primary routing layer untuk Pump.fun tokens; memperkuat moat ekosistem Solana
Pump.fun.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007; Phase 4 Libraries; Phase 7 Major Integrations; Phase 8 Market (Trading Markets: Jupiter)

Pump.fun.title: Deploy ke Blast L2 sebagai chain kedua
Pump.fun.trigger: Ekspansi multi-chain untuk capture Ethereum L2 memecoin mania; Blast menawarkan native yield dan incentives

Sei.trigger: Post-mainnet liquidity bootstrapping selesai; perlu menarik builder jangka panjang; competitor (Aptos, Sui, Berachain) memiliki ecosystem fund ratusan juta USD
Sei.evidence: Ecosystem fund blog announcement; $50M dari community/treasury allocation; grant categories: DeFi, infrastructure, tooling, NFT, gaming
Sei.decision: Alokasi $50M dari Foundation/community treasury untuk grant; application process via forms; tidak ada matching fund requirement publik
Sei.immediate_result: Builder mulai apply; beberapa grant diumumkan via blog/twitter; DragonSwap, Leviathan, Yei menerima early support
Sei.long_term_impact: Fund size moderat vs competitor ($50M vs Aptos $200M+, Sui $100M+); sustainability bergantung pada protocol revenue (fees) dan token price; no public dashboard menciptakan opacity; grant distribution mungkin biased ke early insider projects
Sei.supporting_dataset: Phase 5 Financial (Ecosystem Fund), Phase 6 Token (Foundation Allocation), Phase 7 Ecosystem (Grant Program), Phase 8 Market (Competitor Landscape) Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Cosmos App-Chain" ke "Standalone Parallel Execution L1" · Phase Awal (2021-2022): Whitepaper dan testnet memposisikan Sei sebagai Cosmos SDK chain dengan parallel execution; IBC sebagai primary interoperability; target audience: Cosmos developers · Phase Transisi (2023 Mainnet): Binance listing, Wormhole/Axelar bridges, ERC-20 deploy → positioning shift ke "L1 untuk trading" yang chain-agnostic; marketing mengurangi jargon Cosmos · Phase Sei v2 (2024): EVM compatibility via Geth → target audience berubah ke Ethereum developers; MetaMask integration; "EVM-compatible" menjadi narrative utama; Cosmos/IBC jadi secondary narrative

Sei.title: Mengumumkan dan mengembangkan Sei v2 (EVM via embedded Geth) + SeiDB paralel
Sei.trigger: Persaingan L1 parallel execution (Monad, Berachain, MegaETH) yang menargetkan developer Ethereum; feedback ecosystem butuh EVM compatibility untuk adopsi massal; state bloat menjadi bottleneck
Sei.evidence: Sei v2 blog announcement; SeiDB blog announcement; Trail of Bits audit Sei v2; Oak Security audit SeiDB; testnet July 2024; mainnet upgrade Aug 2024
Sei.decision: Embed Geth sebagai execution client (bukan Ethermint); bangun SeiDB custom storage layer (state store + commit log); precompile contracts untuk native module access; 4 bulan testnet sebelum mainnet upgrade
Sei.immediate_result: EVM JSON-RPC live di mainnet; MetaMask support; Hardhat/Foundry werken; SeiDB aktif; parallel execution applies ke EVM tx
Sei.long_term_impact: Sei menjadi L1 pertama dengan dual VM (CosmWasm + EVM via Geth) di consensus layer yang sama; menarik developer Ethereum tanpa migrasi tooling; SeiDB memposisikan Sei untuk scaling post-v2; technical complexity meningkat (dual VM, cross-VM calls, Geth fork maintenance)
Sei.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017, EV-019, EV-020, Phase 4 Technology (Sei v2 EVM Layer, SeiDB, Precompiles, Audit History), Phase 7 Ecosystem (Major Integrations: Sei v2, MetaMask, SeiDB), Phase 8 Market (Narrative: EVM Compatibility, Competitor Landscape: Monad, Berachain)

Solana.title: Mendirikan Solana Labs dan mengembangkan Proof-of-History sebagai clock terdesentralisasi

Starknet.title: Volition — hybrid DA mode per transaksi

Starknet.decision: Implementasi Volition — developer pilih per transaksi: rollup mode (data on-chain) atau validium mode (off-chain DA committee)
Starknet.immediate_result: Opsi biaya lebih rendah untuk aplikasi toleran trust assumption (gaming, social); rollup mode untuk DeFi high value

Starknet.title: Fee market EIP-1559 style + staking infrastructure
