Uniswap.title: Uniswap v3 Concentrated Liquidity Launch
Uniswap.trigger: Capital inefficiency v2 (liquidity spread 0-infinity); kompetitor mulai menawarkan concentrated liquidity (Curve, then Balancer v2)
Uniswap.evidence: v3 Whitepaper: range orders, multiple fee tiers (0.05%, 0.3%, 1%), NFT positions (ERC-721), TWAP v2; 4000x capital efficiency claim
Uniswap.decision: Redesain fundamental AMM: liquidity concentrated dalam price range, posisi jadi NFT, multiple fee tiers per pool
Uniswap.immediate_result: LP profesional migrasi ke v3; volume share Ethereum naik ke >60%; gas cost position management naik signifikan
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Menjadi standar industri AMM v3 (fork: PancakeSwap v3, SushiSwap Trident, Maverick, Ambient); v4 hooks build on top v3 math
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011, EV-012; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History (v3 launch), Core Components (v3 Pool, NFTPositionManager, SwapRouter), Known Limitations (IL, gas cost, fragmentation)

Uniswap.title: Multi-chain Expansion Starting with Arbitrum One
Uniswap.trigger: Ethereum L1 gas fees >$50-100 membuat retail tidak terjangkau; L2 Arbitrum/Optimism mainnet ready
Uniswap.evidence: v3 deployment identik ke Arbitrum One (EV-013), Optimism (EV-014), Polygon (EV-016), Celo (EV-018), BNB (EV-019), Avalanche (EV-020), Base (EV-022/050), Zora (EV-026), Blast (EV-030), World Chain (EV-031), Unichain (EV-029)
Uniswap.decision: Deploy v3 contracts immutable ke setiap L2/L1 via governance proposal; tidak ada bridge native, mengandalkan bridge eksternal
Uniswap.immediate_result: Volume L2 tumbuh eksponensial; Base menjadi deployment terbesar L2 by TVL/volume; Unichain custom L2 dikembangkan
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Uniswap menjadi protokol multi-chain terbesar; OP Stack menjadi platform dominan (7/12 chains); cross-chain routing need muncul (UniswapX)
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, EV-014, EV-016, EV-018, EV-019, EV-020, EV-022, EV-026, EV-030, EV-031, EV-029; Phase 7 Major Integrations (12 chain deployments), External Dependencies (11 chains)

Uniswap.title: Uniswap Foundation Establishment
Uniswap.trigger: DAO treasury 408.5M UNI membutuhkan manajemen profesional untuk grants, research, protocol development; Labs fokus komersial
Uniswap.evidence: Foundation terpisah dari Labs (Cayman Islands); Executive Director Devin Walsh; Grants Program Wave 1 $1.8M untuk 23 proyek (EV-034)
Uniswap.decision: Yayasan independen menerima alokasi dari DAO treasury via governance; tidak memiliki token allocation genesis
Uniswap.immediate_result: Grants program terstruktur; research funding; protocol development support terpisah dari Labs commercial interest
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Sustainable ecosystem funding; separation of concerns Labs (commercial) vs Foundation (public goods); grants scaling
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-017, EV-034; Phase 2 Entity (Uniswap Foundation), Phase 6 Token Distribution (Foundation no genesis allocation), Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem (Foundation, Grants Committee)

Uniswap.title: Series C Funding Flat Valuation $1.66B untuk Unichain/v4/Wallet
Uniswap.trigger: Bear market 2022; perlu runway untuk R&D jangka panjang (Unichain, v4, Wallet, compliance) tanpa dilusi besar
Uniswap.evidence: Ribbit Capital lead $165M; Gen Digital strategic; a16z/Paradigm/Variant/Haun follow-on; valuasi flat dari Series B
Uniswap.decision: Terima flat round dengan investor strategis (Gen Digital untuk compliance/consumer); dana untuk Unichain, v4, Wallet, London office
Uniswap.immediate_result: Runway extended; Unichain development accelerated; Wallet team hiring; London office opened (EV-042)
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Unichain testnet 2024; v4 audit ongoing; Wallet live; London policy engagement; investor base diversified beyond crypto-native VC
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-021, EV-042; Phase 5 Funding History (Series C), Financial Dependencies (Ribbit, Gen Digital), Phase 2 Entity (Gen Digital, Haun Ventures)

Uniswap.title: UniswapX Dutch Auction Routing Protocol
Uniswap.trigger: MEV sandwich attacks pada AMM v2/v3; user UX buruk (gas, slippage, failed tx); cross-chain fragmentation; CoW Protocol/1inch solver competition
Uniswap.evidence: UniswapX Whitepaper: Dutch auction orders, filler competition, gas-free untuk user, cross-chain via ERC-7683, MEV internalization ke user
Uniswap.decision: Bangun protocol terpisah dari AMM (komplementer); intent-based, solver network, cross-chain native
Uniswap.immediate_result: Whitepaper published; audit ongoing (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin); SDK development; ERC-7683 standard finalized
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Paradigm shift dari AMM-only ke intent-based routing; Unichain native ERC-7683 support; potential protocol fee revenue
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-024; Phase 4 Core Components (UniswapX Order Reactor, Cross-chain Settlement), System Architecture (Cross-chain Messaging ERC-7683), Phase 7 Major Integrations (UniswapX Cross-chain Settlement), External Dependencies (Flashbots, ERC-7683)

Uniswap.title: SEC Wells Notice Response — Public Contest
Uniswap.trigger: SEC mengirim Wells Notice mengindikasikan enforcement action; klaim UNI adalah security dan protokol exchange terdaftar
Uniswap.evidence: Uniswap Labs Blog response: menentang klasifikasi UNI sebagai security; protokol immutable, permissionless, bukan exchange terpusat
Uniswap.decision: Public legal challenge via blog, media, policy engagement; tidak settle diam-diam; hire securities counsel; London office untuk EU/UK regulatory
Uniswap.immediate_result: UNI price volatil (-20%+); community support narratif "protocol not security"; policy team expansion
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Regulatory uncertainty overhang; potential US user restrictions; compliance cost naik; precedent untuk DeFi protocols
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-028; Phase 5 Financial Risk (Legal Financial Risk, Regulatory Uncertainty), Phase 2 Entity (US SEC), Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks (Regulatory Risk SEC Wells Notice) Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari AMM Single-Chain ke Multi-Chain Protocol Layer · Fase 2018-2020: v1/v2 hanya Ethereum mainnet; fokus product-market fit AMM basics · Fase 2021: v3 launch + immediate multi-chain (Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon) — strategi "deploy everywhere" · Fase 2022-2023: 12+ chains deployment via governance; Base menjadi largest L2; OP Stack emerges sebagai platform dominan · Fase 2024: Unichain custom L2 — dari "deploy ke chain orang lain" ke "bangun chain sendiri"; vertikalisasi stack

Uniswap.title: Unichain Custom OP Stack L2 untuk DeFi
Uniswap.trigger: Kebutuhan sequencing revenue, MEV control, cross-chain native (ERC-7683), 1s block time, TEE builder untuk fair ordering; OP Stack modularity memungkinkan customization
Uniswap.evidence: Unichain Blog: OP Stack custom, 1s block time, TEE-based builder, EigenLayer AVS validation, native v4 deployment target
Uniswap.decision: Bangun L2 sendiri bukan cuma deploy ke Base/Optimism; control sequencing, validation, revenue; EigenLayer AVS untuk security
Uniswap.immediate_result: Testnet live Sepolia; v4 hooks deployment target; Validation Network operator recruitment; OP Labs partnership mendalam
Uniswap.long_term_impact: Uniswap menjadi L2 operator; sequencing fees potential DAO revenue; v4 hooks native environment; EigenLayer integration deepened
Uniswap.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-029; Phase 4 Core Components (Unichain Sequencer, Validation Network), System Architecture (Appchain Unichain, Service Network EigenLayer), Phase 7 External Dependencies (OP Labs, EigenLayer), Major Integrations (Unichain)

Vana.title: Meluncurkan Moksha Testnet publik Juli 2023 sebelum mainnet
Vana.trigger: Perlu testing validator set, Data DAO onboarding, PoC mechanism, bridge mechanics di environment live
Vana.evidence: Blog "Introducing Moksha Testnet" 2023-07 [Vana Blog Introducing Moksha, https://blog.vana.org/introducing-moksha-testnet/] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Public testnet dengan validator incentives, Data DAO deployment, community testing ~15 bulan sebelum mainnet
Vana.immediate_result: 5 Data DAO deploy di testnet (r/datadao, Volara, Flirtual, DataPig, Kappa); validator set terbentuk; PoC mechanism diuji
Vana.long_term_impact: Smooth mainnet launch 2024-10-16 dengan Data DAO contracts ready; testnet state migration status tidak terdokumentasi (open thread)
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-004, EV-006 through EV-010, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History

Vana.title: TGE VANA 2024-12-16 via claim portal (Vana Portal) bukan public sale/launchpad
Vana.trigger: Distribusi ke community, Data DAO participants, testnet users tanpa intermediary; regulatory caution pada public sale
Vana.evidence: Blog Token Launch: "claim via Portal"; CEX listings dimulai pasca-TGE [Vana Blog Token Launch, https://blog.vana.org/vana-token-launch/] (HIGH) [Vana Portal, https://portal.vana.org] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Token Generation Event dengan community allocation claimable via Portal; tidak ada fixed-price public sale, launchpad, atau auction
Vana.immediate_result: Token tersebar ke Data DAO contributors, early users; CEX liquidity provided by market makers (tidak diungkap)
Vana.long_term_impact: Price discovery sepenuhnya market-driven post-TGE; no lock-up untuk claim recipients (vesting schedule tidak diungkap); fair launch narrative
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-017, Phase 6 TGE, Phase 6 Vesting Schedule

Vana.title: Membangun Vana-Ethereum Bridge dengan validator set attestation
Vana.trigger: Perlu two-way peg VANA ERC-20 ↔ native VANA untuk liquidity dan user onboarding dari Ethereum ecosystem
Vana.evidence: Whitepaper bridge design; blog mainnet menyebutkan bridge live [Vana Whitepaper, https://vana.org/whitepaper.pdf] (HIGH) [Vana Docs Bridge, https://docs.vana.org] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Validator-set multi-sig/threshold signature bridge model; Vana validators attest mint/burn pada Ethereum contract
Vana.immediate_result: Bridge live sejak mainnet 2024-10-16; VANA transferable cross-chain
Vana.long_term_impact: Bridge trust assumption = honest majority Vana validators; single point of failure untuk asset bridge; bukan trust-minimized seperti IBC light client
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 4 Core Components Bridge, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

Vana.title: Tidak mengumumkan audit keamanan publik untuk core modules, bridge, atau Data DAO contracts
Vana.trigger: Mainnet live dengan value at risk; best practice industri memerlukan audit sebelum mainnet
Vana.evidence: GitHub, Blog, Docs tidak memiliki audit announcements [Vana GitHub, https://github.com/vana-com] (HIGH) [Vana Blog, https://blog.vana.org] (HIGH) [Vana Docs, https://docs.vana.org] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Launch tanpa public audit report; kemungkinan private audit dilakukan tapi tidak diumumkan
Vana.immediate_result: Security researchers/community tidak bisa verify code safety; insurance protocols unlikely to cover
Vana.long_term_impact: Trust deficit untuk institutional adoption; exploit risk tinggi; audit announcement menjadi prerequisite untuk next phase growth
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 4 Audit History, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks, Phase 8 Market Summary Evolution Pattern Strategi: Dari konsep "data liquidity layer" (2021 whitepaper) → testnet dengan 5 Data DAO vertikal (2023) → mainnet sovereign L1 dengan native token (2024-10) → TGE dan public trading (2024-12) → ekosistem expansion phase (2025+)

Vana.title: Mendirikan Vana Foundation di Cayman Islands sebagai entitas hukum
Vana.trigger: Perlu legal wrapper untuk token issuance, treasury management, dan compliance sebelum public launch
Vana.evidence: Vana Foundation GitHub dan team page menyebutkan fondasi Cayman Islands [Vana Foundation GitHub, https://github.com/vana-com] (HIGH) [Vana.org Team, https://vana.org/team] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Membentuk yayasan nirlaba (foundation) di Cayman Islands sebagai entitas resmi mengelola protokol, ekosistem Data DAO, dan governance token VANA
Vana.immediate_result: Entitas hukum tersedia untuk fundraising, token legal opinion, dan treaty compliance
Vana.long_term_impact: Menjadi central point untuk treasury, grants, governance oversight; menciptakan centralization risk (single legal entity)
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Entity Vana Foundation, Phase 3 EV-002, Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem

Vana.title: Memilih arsitektur Cosmos SDK + CometBFT + Ethermint untuk Vana L1
Vana.trigger: Butuh sovereign chain dengan EVM compatibility, modular architecture, IBC native, dan custom modules (PoC, Bridge)
Vana.evidence: Whitepaper arsitektur: Cosmos SDK application layer, CometBFT consensus, Ethermint EVM module [Vana Whitepaper, https://vana.org/whitepaper.pdf] (HIGH) [Vana Docs Architecture, https://docs.vana.org] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Build sovereign L1 berbasis Cosmos SDK bukan deploy sebagai L2/rollup di Ethereum atau gunakan subnet existing chain
Vana.immediate_result: Full control atas consensus, execution, governance parameters; custom PoC module deployment; IBC enabled
Vana.long_term_impact: Higher validator operational burden vs L2; own security budget (VANA staking); bridge dependency untuk Ethereum liquidity; app-chain thesis alignment
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 4 System Architecture, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 8 Narrative Position

Vana.title: Meluncurkan Vana Mainnet 2024-10-16 tanpa VANA token transferable
Vana.trigger: Mainnet butuh native gas token dan staking token untuk validator; TGE memerlukan compliance, exchange coordination, claim infrastructure
Vana.evidence: Mainnet live 2024-10-16 dengan native VANA minted pada genesis; TGE 2024-12-16 terpisah [Vana Blog Mainnet Live, https://blog.vana.org/vana-mainnet-is-live/] (HIGH) [Vana Blog Token Launch, https://blog.vana.org/vana-token-launch/] (HIGH)
Vana.decision: Decouple mainnet genesis (chain live, staking active) dari TGE (token transferable, trading live) ~2 bulan gap
Vana.immediate_result: Validator set earning rewards dari hari 1; Data DAO operating; bridge contracts deployed; TGE claim via Portal
Vana.long_term_impact: Early stakers/validators accumulate VANA sebelum public float; potential insider advantage; regulatory separation chain launch vs token sale
Vana.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, EV-016, Phase 6 Major Token Events

Walrus.date: bukan Proof-of-Replication seperti Filecoin atau endowment seperti Arweave
Walrus.title: Memilih arsitektur erasure coding + proof-of-availability di atas Sui consensus
Walrus.trigger: Kebutuhan throughput tinggi, deletable storage, dan integrasi native Move VM
Walrus.evidence: Whitepaper Walrus menjelaskan desain erasure coding (Red Stuff) + proof-of-availability (Blue Stuff) yang berbeda dari Filecoin/Arweave
Walrus.decision: Arsitektur 2-layer: Red Stuff (encoding/distribution) + Blue Stuff (availability proofs via Sui consensus)
Walrus.immediate_result: Testnet live 2024 dengan ~50-100 storage nodes, Walrus Sites, Seal encryption
Walrus.long_term_impact: Diferensiasi teknis vs kompetitor; trade-off: dependency pada Sui validator set untuk consensus
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 4 Technology (Architecture, Consensus, Whitepaper), Phase 8 Market (Competitor Landscape)

Walrus.title: Mysten Labs mendirikan Walrus sebagai protocol storage terpisah dari Sui core
Walrus.trigger: Kebutuhan lapisan storage terprogram untuk aplikasi Sui yang tidak terpenuhi oleh existing solutions (Filecoin/Arweave tidak native ke Move/Sui)
Walrus.evidence: Mysten Labs Series A (Dec 2021) dan Series B (Sep 2022) funding untuk membangun Sui + ecosystem infrastructure termasuk Walrus
Walrus.decision: Membangun Walrus sebagai protocol terpisah di atas Sui consensus, bukan sebagai fitur built-in Sui
Walrus.immediate_result: Tim terdedikasi Walrus, whitepaper, arsitektur erasure coding + proof-of-availability
Walrus.long_term_impact: Walrus menjadi core infrastructure Sui ecosystem; memungkinkan Walrus Sites, Seal, programmable storage
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (Mysten Labs Series A 2021-12, Series B 2022-09), Phase 4 Technology (Architecture), Phase 1 Foundation

Walrus.title: Bergantung sepenuhnya pada treasury Mysten Labs tanpa treasury Walrus terpisah/transparan
Walrus.trigger: Walrus adalah produk internal Mysten Labs, bukan entity legal terpisah awalnya
Walrus.evidence: Tidak ada transparency report Walrus; semua funding via Mysten Labs rounds; FTX Ventures equity di Mysten Labs bukan Walrus langsung
Walrus.decision: Operasional Walrus difunding dari treasury Mysten Labs ($428M total raised)
Walrus.immediate_result: Capital cukup untuk development panjang; tidak perlu token sale awal
Walrus.long_term_impact: Ketidaktransparan allocation Walrus-specific; FTX exposure risk; DAO formation kompleks (harus carve-out dari Mysten Labs)
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 5 Financial (Funding History, Treasury, Financial Dependencies, Financial Risk), Phase 2 Entity (Mysten Labs, FTX Ventures) Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari "Sui storage layer" → "Cross-chain programmable storage platform"

Walrus.title: Partnership Wormhole untuk cross-chain bukan bridge custom atau IBC
Walrus.trigger: Kebutuhan akses cross-chain cepat tanpa membangun bridge infrastructure sendiri
Walrus.evidence: Wormhole announcement blog 2024; Wormhole NTT/Gateway digunakan; bukan IBC (Sui tidak native IBC) atau LayerZero
Walrus.decision: Integrasi Wormhole untuk cross-chain blob access dan messaging
Walrus.immediate_result: Announcement saja, belum live; technical specs tidak dipublikasikan
Walrus.long_term_impact: Dependency pada Wormhole security; memperluas TAM ke non-Sui chains; risiko bridge exploit
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Entity (Wormhole dependency), Phase 3 History (Wormhole announcement 2024), Phase 7 Ecosystem (Wormhole integration planned), Phase 8 Market (Cross-chain narrative)

Walrus.title: Launch testnet permissioned terlebih dahulu sebelum mainnet permissionless
Walrus.trigger: Kebutuhan hardening protocol, testing economics, validator operations sebelum permissionless
Walrus.evidence: Testnet docs menunjukkan permissioned validator set, test SUI tokens, no real fees; Mysten Labs mengoperasikan mayoritas infrastructure
Walrus.decision: Testnet permissioned ~6-12 bulan sebelum mainnet; community validators diundang tapi curated
Walrus.immediate_result: Akord, Decrypt Media, Seal integration live di testnet; developer feedback loop
Walrus.long_term_impact: Mengurangi risiko mainnet launch; tapi menunda desentralisasi nyata dan token launch
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 History (Walrus Testnet Launch 2024), Phase 7 Ecosystem (Infrastructure Providers, Validator Group), Phase 5 Financial (No live revenue)

Walrus.title: Tidak meluncurkan token WAL bersamaan dengan testnet; menunggu mainnet readiness
Walrus.trigger: Hindari token launch prematur tanpa utility nyata, regulatory clarity, dan mainnet economics teruji
Walrus.evidence: Tidak ada WAL token di testnet (menggunakan test SUI); tokenomics doc referenced tapi tidak public; tidak ada TGE date announcement
Walrus.decision: Delay token launch hingga mainnet; testnet menggunakan test tokens
Walrus.immediate_result: Tidak ada speculative trading, fokus pada product-market fit; tapi tidak ada incentive mechanism untuk storage nodes nyata
Walrus.long_term_impact: Tokenomics design space lebih luas; risiko community impatience; competitor (0G, Celestia) sudah launch token
Walrus.supporting_dataset: Phase 5 Financial (Token Sale: not announced), Phase 6 Token (WAL not launched), Phase 8 Market (Trading Markets: N/A)

Wormhole.title: Menginkubasi Wormhole sebagai proyek internal Jump Crypto
Wormhole.trigger: Kebutuhan infrastruktur cross-chain yang aman untuk ekosistem Solana yang sedang berkembang; Jump Crypto ingin mengisi celah interoperabilitas
Wormhole.evidence: Jump Crypto memulai pengembangan Wormhole sebagai proyek internal sejak 2020 (HIGH) [Jump Crypto Blog, https://jumpcrypto.com/writing/wormhole/; Wormhole Blog Foundation, https://wormhole.com/blog/introducing-wormhole-foundation/]
Wormhole.decision: Dedikasikan tim engineering Jump Crypto untuk membangun arsitektur guardian network + VAA (Verifiable Action Approval) sebagai fondasi protokol cross-chain
Wormhole.immediate_result: Codebase awal Wormhole Core Bridge dan guardian network siap untuk testnet (EV-001)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menetapkan fundamental arsitektur guardian-based yang tetap dipakai hingga saat ini; menentukan "reputational security" model
Wormhole.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-001, Phase 2 (Jump Crypto as Entity)

Wormhole.title: Meluncurkan mainnet V1 Solana ↔ Ethereum
Wormhole.trigger: Testnet sukses Agustus 2021; adopsi Solana meningkat; kebutuhan jembatan token dan message passing production-ready
Wormhole.evidence: Mainnet V1 diluncurkan September 2021 dengan 19 guardian (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog V1 Launch, https://wormhole.com/blog/wormhole-v1-mainnet-launch/; Solana Blog, https://solana.com/news/wormhole-bridge-launches]
Wormhole.decision: Fokus awal pada koneksi dua chain paling signifikan saat itu (Solana-Ethereum) untuk membangun utility minimum viable
Wormhole.immediate_result: Token bridging dan arbitrary message passing live; TVL mulai masuk (EV-003)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menjadi salah satu bridge pertama yang menghubungkan Solana dan Ethereum; membangun reputasi early-mover di interoperabilitas

Wormhole.title: Menutup lubang exploit $320M dengan menambah likuiditas dari Jump Crypto
Wormhole.trigger: Exploit 120k wETH pada 2 Februari 2022; pengguna menghadapi potensi kehilangan dana besar
Wormhole.evidence: Jump Crypto mengonfirmasi mengisi 120.000 ETH (~$320M) untuk menutupi kerugian pengguna (HIGH) [Jump Crypto Blog Incident, https://jumpcrypto.com/writing/wormhole-incident/; Wormhole Blog Incident, https://wormhole.com/blog/wormhole-incident-report/]
Wormhole.decision: Jump Crypto memprioritaskan kontinuitas operasional dan kepercayaan pengguna atas biaya finansial langsung
Wormhole.immediate_result: Pengguna tidak mengalami kerugian dana; protokol dijeda sementara untuk patch (EV-004, EV-005)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Memperlihatkan komitmen terhadap user protection; membangun reputasi responsif pasca-insiden; memicu audit menyeluruh

Wormhole.title: Ekspansi multi-chain dengan V2
Wormhole.trigger: Permintaan pasar untuk bridging ke L2 dan chain non-EVM; mengenali dominasi Solana-Ethereum tidak cukup untuk skala protokol
Wormhole.evidence: V2 menambahkan Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Aptos, Sui (HIGH) [Wormhole Docs Supported Networks, https://docs.wormhole.com/wormhole/overview/supported-networks; Wormholescan Networks, https://wormholescan.io/networks]
Wormhole.decision: Prioritaskan breadth of chain support untuk mengamankan posisi sebagai interoperabilitas universal
Wormhole.immediate_result: Wormhole menjadi bridge multi-chain terbesar; TVL cross-chain meningkat signifikan (EV-006)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menyediakan fondasi untuk ekosistem integrasi yang luas hingga saat ini

Wormhole.title: Membentuk Wormhole Foundation di Cayman Islands
Wormhole.trigger: Kebutuhan legal wrapper untuk governance, treasury, dan pengelolaan protokol independen dari Jump Crypto
Wormhole.evidence: Foundation didirikan di Cayman Islands untuk mengelola governance, treasury, dan pengembangan protokol (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog Foundation, https://wormhole.com/blog/introducing-wormhole-foundation/; Cayman Islands Registry, https://www.ciiregistry.ky/]
Wormhole.decision: Transisi dari inkubasi Jump Crypto ke entitas independen untuk mengurangi dependensi founder dan mempersiapkan token governance
Wormhole.immediate_result: Struktur governance formal; transisi mulai berjalan (EV-010)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menyediakan jalur menuju DAO governance yang desentralisasi; memungkinkan TGE tanpa Founder Single Point of Failure
Wormhole.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, Phase 2 (Wormhole Foundation as Entity)

Wormhole.title: Meluncurkan NTT (Native Token Transfers) sebagai framework token sovereignty
Wormhole.trigger: Keinginan untuk menyediakan standar native token transfer yang lebih baik daripada lock/mint bridge; kelemahan utang token bridged (liquidity fragmentation)
Wormhole.evidence: NTT mengumumkan framework untuk single supply dan sovereignty token di multi-chain (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog NTT, https://wormhole.com/blog/native-token-transfers/]
Wormhole.decision: Investasikan development effort ke framework yang menempatkan control token issuer sebagai prioritas; instead of bridge-controlled liquidity
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menjadi standar de-facto untuk native token cross-chain; dipakai oleh W token sendiri dan 50+ token lain (EV-021)

Wormhole.title: Integrasi Circle CCTP untuk native USDC
Wormhole.trigger: Fragmentation stablecoin antar chain; kebutuhan likuiditas native USDC untuk DeFi lintas rantai
Wormhole.evidence: Circle CCTP terintegrasi dengan Wormhole untuk native USDC burn/mint (HIGH) [Wormhole Ecosystem, https://wormhole.com/ecosystem; Circle CCTP, https://www.circle.com/cross-chain-transfer-protocol]
Wormhole.decision: Kolaborasi dengan Circle untuk menyediakan USDC asli lintas chain, mengurangi bridged wUSDC
Wormhole.immediate_result: Native USDC cross-chain transfer live; likuiditas terfragmentasi berkurang (EV-014)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menegaskan posisi Wormhole sebagai infrastruktur untuk stablecoin utama; memudahkan institusi untuk menggunakan Wormhole

Wormhole.title: TGE dan peluncuran W token via airdrop
Wormhole.trigger: Persiapan DAO governance; kebutuhan voting power untuk parameter protokol; tokenomics sudah dirancang sejak lama
Wormhole.evidence: W token genesis mint 10M di Solana; airdrop ke kontributor ekosistem, guardian, early users; multi-chain deployment via NTT (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog W Token Launch, https://wormhole.com/blog/w-token-launch/; Solscan, https://solscan.io/token/worm2ZoG2kUd4vFXhvjh93UUH596ayRfgQ2MgjNMTth]
Wormhole.decision: Desain token dengan kontribusi masyarakat dan airdrop besar (17% Community) untuk bootstrap desentralisasi
Wormhole.immediate_result: DAO aktif; price discovery via CEX listings (EV-016, EV-019)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Governance token menjadi mekanisme kontrol protokol; risiko regulasi klasifikasi token masih mengemuka
Wormhole.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-018, EV-019, Phase 6 (TGE, Governance)

Wormhole.title: Meluncurkan Wormhole ZK testnet
Wormhole.trigger: Keinginan mengurangi trust assumption guardian network; persiapan V3 modular
Wormhole.evidence: ZK light client testnet menggunakan RISC Zero/SP1 untuk verifikasi trust-minimized (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog ZK, https://wormhole.com/blog/category/integrations/; Docs Products, https://docs.wormhole.com/wormhole/overview/products]
Wormhole.decision: Investasikan R&D untuk ZK verification path, tidak hanya patch guardian set yang ada
Wormhole.immediate_result: Developer dapat menguji ZK verification; path ke production ZK light client dibuka (EV-020)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Potensi menurunkan biaya kepercayaan; menarik user yang skeptical terhadap guardian-based

Wormhole.title: Meluncurkan Wormhole Queries mainnet beta
Wormhole.trigger: Kebutuhan dApp untuk akses data cross-chain tanpa menjalankan node atau bridging asset; permintaan developer
Wormhole.evidence: Queries mainnet beta memungkinkan kueri state/event antar chain (HIGH) [Wormhole Blog Queries, https://wormhole.com/blog/category/integrations/; Docs Products, https://docs.wormhole.com/wormhole/overview/products]
Wormhole.decision: Tambahkan data access layer terpisah dari messaging core untuk menjawab pain point developer
Wormhole.immediate_result: Cross-chain data queries live; use case seperti portfolio tracking dan DeFi analytics (EV-022)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Memperluas revenue stream potensial; meningkatkan developer utility

Wormhole.title: Publikasi RFC V3 untuk arsitektur modular
Wormhole.trigger: Kompleksitas meningkat; kebutuhan pluggable verification; scalability dan gas efficiency
Wormhole.evidence: V3 RFC mengusulkan modular architecture, pluggable verification (ZK/TEE/SGX), enhanced NTT, dan gas-efficient messaging (MEDIUM) [GitHub RFC V3, https://github.com/wormhole-foundation/wormhole/blob/main/RFCs/v3-architecture.md]
Wormhole.decision: Desain ulang inti protokol sebelum masalah besar terjadi; bukan menunggu krisis
Wormhole.immediate_result: Spesifikasi terbuka untuk feedback komunitas; audit dan testnet persiapan dimulai (EV-024)
Wormhole.long_term_impact: Menetapkan path ke trust-minimized dan skala lebih besar; potensi perubahan arsitektur besar
Wormhole.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-024, Phase 4 (Current Technical Stack) ## Evolution Pattern Pola 1: Dari Bridge Spesifik ke Interoperabilitas Universal · Change: Awalnya hanya bridge Solana ↔ Ethereum (EV-003); berkembang menjadi protokol multi-chain 20+ chain (EV-006, EV-012, EV-014)

dYdX.title: Pendirian dYdX Trading Inc. sebagai Delaware corporation di New York
dYdX.trigger: Antonio Juliano ingin membangun decentralized margin trading di Ethereum; butuh entitas hukum untuk fundraising dan operasi
dYdX.evidence: Phase 1 Foundation (Founding Entity: dYdX Trading Inc., Delaware, USA); Phase 2 Entity (dYdX Trading Inc., Type: Company, Relationship: Entitas pendiri); Phase 3 EV-001
dYdX.decision: Mendirikan dYdX Trading Inc. sebagai entitas komersial US untuk mengembangkan protokol
dYdX.immediate_result: Entitas hukum resmi untuk seed funding (Polychain Capital 2017-12, EV-002) dan pengembangan v1
dYdX.long_term_impact: Struktur dual-entity (US company + Swiss foundation) yang memengaruhi regulasi, IP, dan treasury management hingga sekarang
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 1 Foundation, Phase 2 Entity (dYdX Trading Inc.), Phase 3 EV-001, EV-002

dYdX.title: Luncurkan dYdX v1 Solo Margin di Ethereum Mainnet
dYdX.trigger: Membuktikan konsep decentralized margin trading on-chain tanpa kewenangan pusat
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-003; Phase 1 Launch Date Mainnet 2018-06; Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History (v1 Solo Margin 2018-06)
dYdX.decision: Deploy smart contract Solidity untuk solo margin trading ETH/DAI, WETH/DAI di Ethereum L1
dYdX.immediate_result: Produk pertama live, volume awal, validasi product-market fit
dYdX.long_term_impact: Menetapkan arsitektur on-chain settlement + off-chain orderbook yang berkembang ke v2/v3/v4
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-003, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History, Phase 8 Market Timeline

dYdX.title: Migrasi ke StarkEx Validium L2 untuk v3
dYdX.trigger: Ethereum L1 gas fee tinggi dan throughput rendah membatasi UX trading; butuh 0 gas fee dan finalitas cepat
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-008 (testnet), EV-009 (mainnet); Phase 4 Architecture (Previous v3: StarkEx Validium); Phase 4 Consensus (Previous: StarkEx ZK-STARK); Phase 8 Market Timeline (2021-04-20)
dYdX.decision: Bangun v3 di atas StarkEx (StarkWare) dengan orderbook off-chain, ZK-STARK validity proofs settlement di Ethereum
dYdX.immediate_result: Volume trading miliaran USD/bulan, 0 gas fee untuk trader, 20x leverage; menjadi produk utama 2021-2024
dYdX.long_term_impact: Membuktikan model hybrid off-chain orderbook + on-chain settlement; tapi ketergantungan pada operator terpusat (StarkWare) memicu keputusan migrasi ke sovereign appchain
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, EV-009, Phase 4 Architecture, Phase 8 Market Timeline

dYdX.title: Token Generation Event DYDX ERC-20 + Governance Launch
dYdX.trigger: Butuh token untuk governance, staking, fee discounts, dan incentive alignment; Series C funding $65M (EV-007) memberikan runway
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-010 (TGE), EV-011 (CEX listings), EV-012 (Governance launch); Phase 6 TGE, Distribution, Vesting; Phase 5 Funding (Series C $65M a16z lead)
dYdX.decision: Launch DYDX ERC-20 di Ethereum dengan airdrop 7.5% supply, liquidity mining 5 tahun, vesting team/investor 5 tahun (1-year cliff); governance via Snapshot
dYdX.immediate_result: Token listed Binance/Coinbase/Kraken same day; $1B+ FDV; community ownership dimulai
dYdX.long_term_impact: Tokenomics inflationary dengan 1B initial supply; governance DAO mengarahkan protokol; migrasi ke native token dYdX Chain 2023
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, EV-011, EV-012, Phase 5 Funding, Phase 6 Token (TGE, Distribution, Vesting, Governance)

dYdX.title: Rilis Whitepaper dYdX Chain (v4) - Sovereign Cosmos Appchain
dYdX.trigger: Keterbatasan StarkEx: operator terpusat, tidak sovereign, custom VM, tidak IBC-native, fee switch sulit diimplementasikan
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-016; Phase 4 Architecture (Appchain Cosmos SDK/CometBFT); Phase 4 Consensus (CometBFT BFT PoS); Phase 1 Launch Date Mainnet 2023-10-26
dYdX.decision: Desain appchain sovereign: Cosmos SDK modules (x/perp, x/clob, x/staking, x/gov), CometBFT consensus, Celestia DA, IBC-native, native DYDX token, validator-operated CLOB
dYdX.immediate_result: Spesifikasi teknis lengkap untuk migrasi; testnet 2023-05 (EV-018); mainnet 2023-10-26 (EV-023)
dYdX.long_term_impact: Kontrol penuh stack teknis; modular architecture (Celestia DA, IBC); tapi kompleksitas operasional meningkat (validator set, relayer, DA layer dependency)
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-018, EV-023, Phase 4 Architecture, Consensus, DA Layer, Phase 8 Market Timeline

dYdX.title: Peluncuran dYdX Foundation terpisah dari dYdX Trading Inc.
dYdX.trigger: Perlu entitas non-profit untuk mengelola ekosistem jangka panjang, grants, governance, terpisah dari entitas komersial US (regulatory separation)
dYdX.evidence: Phase 2 Entity (dYdX Foundation, Type: Foundation, Relationship: Yayasan non-profit terpisah); Phase 3 EV-017; Phase 1 Core Team (Charles d'Haussy CEO Foundation)
dYdX.decision: Mendirikan dYdX Foundation (jurisdiksi diduga Switzerland, LOW confidence) dengan Charles d'Haussy sebagai CEO; dYdX Trading Inc. tetap entity US
dYdX.immediate_result: Structure dual-entity formal; Foundation mengelola grants, ecosystem, governance; Trading Inc. fokus komersial
dYdX.long_term_impact: Pemisahan legal/IP/treasury antara US entity dan Foundation; pertanyaan terbuka soal IP licensing, revenue sharing, operational funding (Open Threads Phase 2, 5, 7)
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Entity (dYdX Foundation, dYdX Trading Inc.), Phase 3 EV-017, Phase 5 Financial Dependencies, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

dYdX.title: Integrasi Celestia sebagai Data Availability Layer
dYdX.trigger: Butuh DA layer scalable dan cost-efficient untuk orderbook off-chain throughput tinggi; Ethereum calldata terlalu mahal
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-021, EV-028; Phase 4 Architecture (DA Layer: Celestia Blobstream); Phase 4 Core Components (Celestia Blobstream); Phase 7 External Dependencies (Celestia: Critical)
dYdX.decision: Adopsi Celestia Blobstream: validator submit blob orderbook ke Celestia, light client Blobstream verifikasi on-chain via IBC
dYdX.immediate_result: DA layer modular live; verifikasi DA trust-minimized via IBC channel ke Celestia (EV-028)
dYdX.long_term_impact: Dependency kritis pada Celestia (Single DA Layer Risk Phase 7); jika Celestia down, orderbook DA verification gagal; first major appchain menggunakan Celestia Blobstream
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-021, EV-028, Phase 4 Architecture, Phase 7 External Dependencies, Ecosystem Risks

dYdX.title: Luncuran dYdX Chain Mainnet + Token Migration Program
dYdX.trigger: Siap production setelah testnet 5 bulan; butuh migrasi DYDX ERC-20 → native DYDX untuk staking/gas/governance di chain baru
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-023 (mainnet), EV-024 (migration), EV-025 (IBC Osmosis); Phase 6 Major Token Events (EV-023, EV-024, EV-025); Phase 8 Market Timeline
dYdX.decision: Mainnet live dengan 50 validator genesis; native DYDX (bech32 prefix: dydx); bridging via Axelar/Wormhole; IBC channel ke Osmosis
dYdX.immediate_result: Sovereign appchain live; trading perpetuals native; staking/governance on-chain; dual-chain token period (ERC-20 + native)
dYdX.long_term_impact: v3 StarkEx deprecated 2024-01 (EV-026); fokus 100% dYdX Chain; migration ongoing; bridge dependency (Axelar/Wormhole) menjadi critical path
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-023, EV-024, EV-025, EV-026, Phase 6 Major Token Events, Phase 8 Market Timeline

dYdX.title: Deprekasi resmi dYdX v3 StarkEx
dYdX.trigger: Migrasi ke dYdX Chain selesai; v3 tidak sustainable (operator terpusat, biaya StarkWare, tidak sovereign)
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-026; Phase 4 Core Components (StarkEx Contracts deprecated); Phase 8 Market Timeline (2024-01)
dYdX.decision: Tutup frontend v3, hentikan trading, read-only withdrawal only; kontrak StarkEx immutable
dYdX.immediate_result: Semua resource fokus dYdX Chain; v3 menjadi legacy; TVL v3 ~$0 post-deprecation (Phase 8 TVL v3)
dYdX.long_term_impact: No turning back - kontrak immutable; bridge contracts menjadi satu-satunya exit untuk ERC-20 holders; technical debt locked
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-026, Phase 4 Core Components, Phase 8 Adoption Metrics (TVL v3)

dYdX.title: Proposal Fee Switch Activation di dYdX Chain
dYdX.trigger: Komunitas ingin revenue share ke staker (DIP-2 passed 2021 v3 tapi tidak diimplementasikan); butuh sustainable staking yield
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-013 (DIP-2 v3), EV-027 (v4 proposal); Phase 6 Utility (Fee Switch Planned); Phase 5 Revenue Model (Fee Switch Proposed); Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks (Fee Switch Uncertainty)
dYdX.decision: On-chain governance proposal untuk mengaktifkan fee switch (% trading fee → staker)
dYdX.immediate_result: Proposal pada voting/execution phase; status implementasi tidak diverifikasi on-chain (Open Threads)
dYdX.long_term_impact: Jika lulus, mengubah tokenomics dari pure inflationary ke fee-revenue-sharing; mempengaruhi staking APY, token demand, treasury allocation
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-013, EV-027, Phase 5 Revenue Model, Phase 6 Utility, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

dYdX.title: Inflation Parameter Adjustment Proposal
dYdX.trigger: Optimalkan keamanan jaringan (target bonded ratio) dan insentif staker; inflation saat ini mungkin terlalu tinggi/rendah
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-033; Phase 6 Inflation (Dynamic inflation berbasis target bonded ratio); Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks (Inflationary Supply Without Hard Cap)
dYdX.decision: Governance proposal menyesuaikan parameter inflasi (target bonded ratio, min/max inflation rate)
dYdX.immediate_result: Proposal pada voting; parameter aktif saat ini tidak diverifikasi (Open Threads)
dYdX.long_term_impact: Menentukan supply growth rate, staking yield, token dilution; critical untuk long-term tokenomics sustainability
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-033, Phase 6 Inflation, Phase 7 Ecosystem Risks

dYdX.title: IBC Channel ke Noble (USDC Native Cosmos)
dYdX.trigger: Butuh USDC native Cosmos untuk collateral/settlement tanpa bridge Ethereum risk/cost
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-034; Phase 7 Major Integrations (IBC Channel dYdX Chain ↔ Noble); Phase 4 Core Components (IBC Module)
dYdX.decision: Buka IBC channel ke Noble chain (penerbit USDC native Cosmos) untuk transfer USDC langsung ke dYdX Chain
dYdX.immediate_result: USDC native Cosmos tersedia di dYdX Chain; mengurangi dependency bridge Ethereum untuk collateral
dYdX.long_term_impact: Mendorong adopsi institusional (USDC native trusted); memperkuat positioning dYdX Chain sebagai DeFi hub Cosmos; mengurangi bridge risk
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-034, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 4 Core Components

dYdX.title: Rencana v5.0 Upgrade + Permissionless Market Maker
dYdX.trigger: Perlu improve orderbook performance, modularisasi, fitur baru (options), dan desentralisasi likuiditas
dYdX.evidence: Phase 3 EV-035 (v5.0), EV-036 (permissionless MM); Phase 4 Known Limitations (throughput, validator permissioned); Phase 8 Market Timeline
dYdX.decision: Protocol upgrade via governance: orderbook performance, modularisasi module, dukungan options/structured products; buka orderbook ke external MM via staking DYDX/USDC deposit (no whitelist)
dYdX.immediate_result: Roadmap dipublikasikan; hackathon "Perpetual Builders" 2024-10 (EV-032) untuk ecosystem tooling
dYdX.long_term_impact: Transisi dari permissioned validator/MM ke fully permissionless; mengurangi centralization risk; mempersiapkan kompetisi dengan Hyperliquid, Vertex, dll
dYdX.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-032, EV-035, EV-036, Phase 4 Known Limitations, Phase 8 Market Timeline Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Ethereum L1/L2 App → Sovereign Appchain

zkSync.title: Boojum prover testnet integration (2024-07) targeting mainnet migration
zkSync.trigger: PLONK prover limitations (throughput, hardware, centralization); STARK recursive advantages
zkSync.evidence: Boojum announcement 2023; testnet integration 2024; era-prover repo active (Phase 3 EV-011, EV-024, EV-025, Phase 4 Prover Boojum, Phase 8 Narrative Position)
zkSync.decision: Migrate dari PLONK (SNARK) ke Boojum (STARK recursive) dengan decentralized prover network vision
zkSync.immediate_result: Benchmarking di testnet; audit ongoing (Trail of Bits)
zkSync.long_term_impact: Critical path untuk decentralization; prover tokenomics undefined; hardware claims ("consumer GPU") unverified at mainnet scale
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-011, EV-024, EV-025, Phase 4 Prover Boojum, Known Technical Limitations, Phase 8 Open Threads Evolution Pattern Perubahan Strategi: Dari Payment-Focused Rollup (v1) ke General-Purpose EVM-Compatible ZK-rollup (v2) ke Modular Sovereign Chain Framework (Stack)

zkSync.title: Pendirian Matter Labs GmbH di Austria
zkSync.trigger: Butuh entitas hukum untuk R&D ZK-rollup dan fundraising
zkSync.evidence: Austrian firm register menunjukkan incorporasi 2018 (Phase 2 Entity Matter Labs GmbH, Phase 3 EV-001)
zkSync.decision: Mendirikan Matter Labs GmbH sebagai entity pendiri
zkSync.immediate_result: Legal entity untuk kontrak, IP, employment, Series A fundraising
zkSync.long_term_impact: Struktur dual-entity (GmbH + Ltd. UK 2022) mendukung operasional global; IP dan token allocation tertaut pada GmbH
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 2 Entity Matter Labs GmbH, Phase 3 EV-001

zkSync.title: Launch zkSync Lite (v1) mainnet sebagai ZK-rollup pertama di Ethereum
zkSync.trigger: Validasi teknis ZK-SNARK (PLONK) untuk payment-focused rollup setelah testnet 2019
zkSync.evidence: Mainnet launch blog Matter Labs; first ZK-rollup live on Ethereum (Phase 3 EV-004, Phase 1 Launch Date Mainnet)
zkSync.decision: Deploy v1 mainnet dengan scope terbatas (ETH/ERC-20 transfer only, no EVM)
zkSync.immediate_result: Proof-of-concept ZK-rollup produksi; user base early adopters; foundation untuk v2
zkSync.long_term_impact: Established "first ZK-rollup" narrative; Lite masuk maintenance mode 2023 (EV-030) setelah Era live
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-002, EV-004, EV-030, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History

zkSync.title: Series C funding $50M led by a16z Crypto
zkSync.trigger: Butuh capital besar untuk Era development, Boojum R&D, ecosystem incentives
zkSync.evidence: Crunchbase funding rounds; a16z lead dengan participasi existing investors (Phase 3 EV-007, Phase 5 Funding History)
zkSync.decision: Equity round $50M at ~$200M+ valuation (reported) dengan token allocation untuk investors
zkSync.immediate_result: Runway untuk Era mainnet 2023, Boojum team expansion, Ignite program funding
zkSync.long_term_impact: Investor token allocation 17.5% (3.675B ZK) dengan 12-month cliff + 36-month linear vesting (cliff ends 2025-06-17); significant future sell pressure
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-007, Phase 5 Funding History, Phase 6 Vesting Schedule

zkSync.title: zkSync Era (v2) testnet launch dengan EVM compatibility dan native AA
zkSync.trigger: Market demand untuk general-purpose ZK-rollup; competitor Scroll/Linea/Starknet development
zkSync.evidence: Testnet launch blog; EraVM, zksolc, account abstraction native dari day one (Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 Execution Environment)
zkSync.decision: Build custom VM (EraVM) + modified Solidity compiler (zksolc) bukan Type 1 zkEVM
zkSync.long_term_impact: EVM-compatibility gaps (gas model, precompiles, opcodes) remain documented trade-offs vs Type 1 zkEVM competitors
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-008, Phase 4 Execution Environment, Known Technical Limitations

zkSync.title: zkSync Era mainnet alpha launch
zkSync.trigger: Testnet maturation; infrastructure integrations ready (Chainlink, The Graph)
zkSync.evidence: Mainnet alpha blog; alpha label dengan throughput/security limits (Phase 3 EV-010, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History)
zkSync.decision: Public mainnet dengan PLONK prover, centralized sequencer/prover, native AA live
zkSync.immediate_result: Bridging live, DeFi deployment (SyncSwap, Velocore), TVL growth to $1.5B peak
zkSync.long_term_impact: Established Era as production ZK-rollup; set stage for Stack framework and TGE
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-010, EV-012-015, EV-029, Phase 4 Technical Upgrade History

zkSync.title: Announce zkSync Stack framework untuk sovereign chains
zkSync.trigger: Competitor frameworks (OP Stack, Polygon CDK, Starknet Stack) gaining traction; modular thesis validation
zkSync.evidence: Stack announcement blog; open-source framework di GitHub (Phase 3 EV-016, Phase 4 zkSync Stack Framework, Phase 7 Major Integrations)
zkSync.decision: Modular framework dengan shared VM, prover, bridging; sovereign chains deploy own sequencer/DA
zkSync.immediate_result: 4 chains mainnet 2024 (Lens, Abstract, Kinto, Sophon - EV-018-021)
zkSync.long_term_impact: New revenue model (unclear monetization); shared prover economics undefined; competes dengan OP Stack free model
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-016, EV-018-021, Phase 4 zkSync Stack Framework, Phase 7 Major Integrations, Phase 8 Open Threads

zkSync.title: ZK Token TGE dengan 17.5% airdrop, simultaneous 9 CEX listing
zkSync.trigger: Protocol maturity, ecosystem size, need untuk governance decentralization, liquidity untuk token utility
zkSync.evidence: TGE blog; 21B fixed supply; distribution categories defined; governance forum live (Phase 3 EV-022, EV-023, Phase 6 Token Information, Distribution, Governance)
zkSync.decision: Public launch dengan broad distribution (airdrop, ecosystem, team, investors, treasury); no private sale separate from equity rounds
zkSync.immediate_result: $3.5B-$4.5B FDV; token tradable; governance active; staking/contracts referenced but not deployed
zkSync.long_term_impact: 37.5% supply (team + investors) cliff 2025-06-17 creates sell pressure; treasury 27.7% controlled by Matter Labs multisig pending DAO transition
zkSync.supporting_dataset: Phase 3 EV-022, EV-023, Phase 6 TGE, Distribution, Vesting, Governance, Phase 7 Governance Ecosystem
